About Tech Talent South
-----------------------

Tech Talent & Strategy (formerly Tech Talent South), is a woman-owned tech recruitment, training, and staffing company that believes everyone can be equipped to do something big.  
  
We exist to create opportunities for people: to listen, mentor, and connect them with resources. When you join TTS, you become a member of a national team of thinkers, creators, dreamers, and doers. We are building a diverse tech community for a better future, one person at a time.  
  
From its foundation, TTS has been about people – and even though we’re growing (with a nationwide network of 70,000+ students, alumni, instructors, community partners & corporate clients), we just like to say we’re adding to the family!  
  
Whether you’re an individual trying to gain tech skills, a company trying to fill roles, or a municipality trying to up-skill your local community – TTS is the place for you!  
  
Awarded:  
  
\- Early Talent Award - Education & Nonprofit by Handshake (2022)  
\- Best Woman-Owned Tech Recruitment Firm - South Atlantic US by New World Report (2020)  
\- Best Places to Work by Charlotte Business Journal (2020)  
\- Fast 50 by Charlotte Business Journal (2018)  
\- Winner Charlotte Blue Diamond Awards - Human Capital by IT-oLogy (2017)  
\- Best Coding Bootcamp by Switchup (2016-2021)  
\- Best Bootcamp by Course Report (2017-2021)

### Frequently Asked Questions about Tech Talent South

Who is the CEO of Tech Talent & Strategy?

Betsy Hauser is the CEO of Tech Talent & Strategy. To contact Betsy Hauser email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
 or [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
. Or you may call +1.7049645467

Who are the decision makers in Tech Talent & Strategy?

The decision makers in Tech Talent & Strategy are [Betsy Hauser](https://contactout.com/Betsy-Hauser-529166)
, etc. Click to Find [Tech Talent & Strategy decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Tech%20Talent%20&%20Strategy&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What services does Tech Talent & Strategy offer?

Tech Talent & Strategy provides a range of services including recruitment, technical training, staff augmentation, and workforce development. Their focus is on equipping individuals and organizations with the skills and talent necessary to thrive in the tech industry. They specialize in learning and development programs tailored to meet the needs of tech startups and established companies alike.

How does Tech Talent & Strategy support tech startups?

Tech Talent & Strategy offers tailored solutions for tech startups, including recruitment services to find the right talent and training programs to upskill existing employees. They understand the unique challenges faced by startups and provide flexible staffing options, allowing startups to scale their teams efficiently while maintaining a focus on their core business objectives.

What types of training programs are available?

Tech Talent & Strategy offers a variety of technical training programs designed to enhance the skills of individuals in areas such as software development, data analytics, and project management. These programs are designed to be hands-on and practical, ensuring participants gain real-world experience and knowledge that can be applied immediately in their roles.

Can Tech Talent & Strategy assist with contingent staffing needs?

Yes, Tech Talent & Strategy provides contingent staffing solutions to help organizations meet their temporary workforce needs. This includes sourcing qualified candidates for short-term projects or peak workloads, allowing companies to remain agile and responsive to changing demands without the long-term commitment of permanent hires.

What industries does Tech Talent & Strategy serve?

Tech Talent & Strategy serves a diverse range of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, and education. Their expertise in tech recruitment and training allows them to cater to the specific needs of each industry, ensuring that clients receive customized solutions that align with their operational goals and workforce requirements.

How does Tech Talent & Strategy ensure the quality of their candidates?

Tech Talent & Strategy employs a rigorous recruitment process that includes thorough screening, skills assessments, and interviews to ensure candidates meet the specific needs of their clients. Additionally, they leverage their extensive network and industry knowledge to identify top talent, ensuring that the candidates they present are not only qualified but also a good cultural fit for the organization.

About Total People Solutions
----------------------------

This is a Functional Outsourcing Business Model.Our Clients are not liable, in terms of Section 198(2) of the LRA and LRAA, and the Deeming Clause is not applicable to Clients. This will allow TPS to become the sole Employer of the Employees Function(s)-which are ring-fenced.To ensure the above is a managed service relationship, all instructions and supervision to TPS Employees will come from TPS only. TPS will provide the Employees with capital equipment (where required) and do all the development and training of Employees. TPS will manage the total employment cycle from hire to retire, including payroll, HR and IR Function (but not limited to), and source and place Employees.TPS will be responsible for the agreed SLA objectives with the Client.The benefits of (TPS) Functional Outsourcing:It is trite that Companies outsource for a myriad of reasons. For smaller businesses, outsourcing might become necessary when the company needs to concentrate on their core processes, and relegate non-strategic core areas to a specialist company with the resources and know-how.It makes good business sense to outsource non-core or specialised areas. This does not only cut costs, but frees up valuable time for the Client’s employees to perform their most essential tasks.Given the current state of the market, every company wants to achieve cost savings and further wants to focus on what they know best and factors such as access to innovation, increased speed to market, and service quality are very vital, all of which, in our view combine to make Functional Outsourcing a worthwhile value proposition.Total People Solutions (TPS) are a specialist Functional Outsourcing Company that provide a valuable service to businesses by providing a specialised-tailor made Service in respect of non-core or specialised Functions.

About Quality Aluminum Products
-------------------------------

Quality Aluminum Products, Inc. is a family owned and operated manufacturer of residential aluminum building products. Our product line includes aluminum siding, soffit, fascia, trim coil, and rain carrying products. We also distribute Nailite International Products (brick, stone, and shake), and many other new and exciting building accessories.  
  
The Clark family has been active in the building products industry for nearly 60 years. George and Bob Clark began their careers with Wolverine Aluminum in the early 1950’s. They started Clark Brothers Metal Fabricators in 1971. Clark Brothers was a manufacturer of residential building products with manufacturing plants in Grosse Ile, Michigan and Orlando, Florida. In 1991 Quality Aluminum Products was formed the doors opened with a facility in Flat Rock, Michigan. Quality Aluminum has been blessed with steady growth and currently operates two manufacturing sites. With our 110,000 sq. ft manufacturing facility located in Hastings, Michigan we have the ability to stay competitive in the market. Quality Aluminum is known in the industry as being fair, honest, and upfront with their customers. We have a solid reputation and strive to keep that going into the second generation of the Clark family.  
  
We currently operate our own fleet of trucks; that give us the flexibility and the reputation for excellent delivery and service. We currently deliver materials from the East coast to the Midwest and as far as Omaha, Nebraska. We pride ourselves on putting our customers first and doing everything we can to please our customers. We have an excellent record of safety for our employees and have been awarded one of the State of Michigan’s highest awards for safety achievement. Quality Aluminum Products has also taken on the challenge of being more environmentally friendly. We recycle 100% of all of our scrap metals & packaging materials and continue to find new ways to lessen our impact on the environment.

About GovPayNet
---------------

GovPayNet is a category leader & solution-oriented processor of credit and debit card payments to government agencies. We facilitate quick and convenient payments when it matters. We are a trusted resource that processes more than 2.2 million payments annually for over 2,300 agencies in 35 states.  
  
With over 20 years of service, our reputation speaks for itself bolstered by our commitment to providing superior and innovative payment solutions.  
  
The GovPayNet payment processing solution is provided at no cost to government agencies, although GovPayNet can support flexible pricing models including options for agencies to absorb the GovPayNet service fee. It is a fully Internet-based solution which means no hardware or software costs. GovPayNet accepts the major card brands – MasterCard, Visa, American Express & Discover, including credit, debit and prepaid debit or any combination. Payments can be made onsite, online and by phone, using PCI Level 1-rated technology and processes.

What types of payments does GovPayNet process for government agencies?

GovPayNet specializes in processing various types of payments for government agencies, including credit and debit card payments, cash bail payments, and other fees associated with government services. Our platform supports onsite payments, as well as online and phone payment options, ensuring convenience for users.

How does GovPayNet ensure the security of payment transactions?

GovPayNet prioritizes the security of all payment transactions by utilizing advanced encryption technologies and secure payment gateways. We comply with industry standards, including PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard), to protect sensitive information and ensure that all transactions are processed securely.

Can GovPayNet handle payments for multiple government agencies?

Yes, GovPayNet is designed to accommodate payments for multiple government agencies. Our platform can be customized to meet the specific needs of different agencies, allowing them to manage their payment processing efficiently while providing a seamless experience for their constituents.

What industries does GovPayNet serve?

GovPayNet primarily serves government agencies at various levels, including local, state, and federal entities. Our services are tailored to meet the needs of agencies involved in law enforcement, court systems, tax collection, and other public services that require reliable and efficient payment processing solutions.

Are there options for making payments online or by phone?

Yes, GovPayNet offers flexible payment options, including online payments through our secure portal and payments made by phone. This allows users to choose the most convenient method for making payments, ensuring that they can complete transactions quickly and easily.

What support does GovPayNet provide to agencies and users?

GovPayNet provides comprehensive support to both government agencies and users. Our dedicated customer service team is available to assist with any inquiries related to payment processing, technical issues, or account management. Additionally, we offer training and resources to help agencies effectively utilize our platform for their payment processing needs.

About Riscky's BBQ
------------------

Riscky’s was founded in 1927 by Polish immigrants Mary and Joe Riscky who opened its first location – Riscky’s Grocery & Market – on Azle Avenue on the north side of Fort Worth, Texas. This original location is still open and operating today after four generations of Riscky family ownership, including Mary and Joe’s son Pete Riscky (who took over in 1952), Pete’s son Jim Riscky (who took over in 1976), and now Jim’s son Joe Riscky.  
  
Over the past 86 years, Riscky’s has expanded and evolved into three full-service Riscky’s Barbeque restaurants, three quick-casual Riscky’s BBQ & Deli restaurants, the fine dining Riscky’s Steakhouse, Trailboss Burgers in the historic Fort Worth Stockyards, a full-service catering department, and a retail sales division.  
  
All of Riscky’s barbeque is hand-rubbed with “Riscky Dust” and slow-smoked for hours in smoke pits designed by Jim Riscky that operate 24-hours-a-day at its original Azle Avenue location.

What services does Arkad offer related to used cooking oil (UCO) collection?

Arkad specializes in the collection of used cooking oil (UCO) from various establishments such as restaurants, food processing plants, and catering services. We provide a streamlined collection service that ensures the safe and efficient disposal of UCO, preventing it from being reused in food preparation and promoting its conversion into renewable energy sources.

How does Arkad ensure the quality and safety of the UCO collected?

Arkad follows strict quality control protocols during the collection process. Our trained personnel assess the UCO for contamination and ensure it is stored in appropriate containers to maintain its quality. We also adhere to local regulations and industry standards to guarantee that the UCO collected is suitable for conversion into biofuels.

What industries does Arkad serve with its waste management solutions?

Arkad serves a variety of industries including the food service industry, hospitality, and food manufacturing. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific needs of each sector, ensuring that businesses can manage their waste responsibly while contributing to renewable energy initiatives.

What happens to the used cooking oil after it is collected by Arkad?

Once collected, the used cooking oil is transported to our processing facilities where it undergoes a series of treatments to convert it into waste-based biofuels. This process not only helps in reducing waste but also contributes to the production of sustainable energy, thereby supporting environmental conservation efforts.

Can Arkad help my business transition to more sustainable waste management practices?

Absolutely! Arkad is committed to helping businesses implement sustainable waste management practices. We provide consultation services to assess your current waste disposal methods and offer tailored solutions that include UCO collection and conversion to biofuels, helping you reduce your environmental footprint.

How can I get in touch with Arkad for UCO collection services?

You can easily reach out to Arkad by visiting our website at http://www.arkad.co and filling out the contact form. Alternatively, you can call our customer service line or email us directly to discuss your UCO collection needs and schedule a service.

Point of Difference: We have a proven ability to help brand managers create CPG package designs with both trade and consumer appeal. Sales and marketing experience on the client side plus advertising and design firm expertise gives us a unique understanding of brand manager challenges. And how to succeed in supermarkets and club stores.  
  
Special Expertise:  
• Club Stores: Wright Design created BJ’s Berkley & Jensen signature brand and SKUs for more than 70 categories from candy to paper towels to peanut butter to plastic cutlery to coffee to vitamins and infant formula. We helped Welch’s establish industry standards for single serve and large bottle club packs in Costco, Sam’s Club and BJ’s.  
  
• Natural and Organic Foods: We developed the identity and packaging for Bread & Circus, now Whole Foods supermarkets. Later, we created Earth’s Pride, BJ’s organic and all natural foods brand. We continue to partner with startup natural food brands.  
  
• Specialty Foods: Wright Design is a prime marketing and package design resource for specialty brands like Akara African Beancakes, Edelweiss Patisserie, Himalayan Salt, Hot Mama’s, Budd Foods, Terroir Coffee and Easy Earth cat litter.  
  
• Retailer "Own Brands": For manufacturers, we develop control brands and custom products for upscale retailer brands. With Market Basket and Sprouts we expand their regular and upscale brands.  
  
• Restaurant Brands: We’re partnering with Uno Foods and Legal Sea Foods to extend their strong restaurant brand franchises into supermarkets and club stores.  
  
For Brand Identities, Package Design, Sales Materials and Websites we  
guarantee a single benefit for our marketing brethren: Design That Works

Imagine going to work knowing that what you do each day positively affects the lives of the people in your community. Working at the Y, you'll discover more than a job—you'll enjoy a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in the lives of those around you. Our staff members enjoy the personal satisfaction that comes from nurturing the potential of youth and teens, improving the nation's health and well-being and providing support to our neighbors.

The YMCA of Northern Colorado serves the Northern Front Range of Colorado, including Boulder, Lafayette, Louisville, Longmont, Johnstown, Milliken, Berthoud and beyond.

At the YMCA of Northern Colorado, we are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, sexual orientation or religious affiliation.

About Riverview Bank and its Operating Divisions
------------------------------------------------

Riverview Bank is a $1.2 Billion asset community bank headquartered in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Riverview Bank and its operating divisions -- CBT Bank, Citizens Neighborhood Bank, CBT Financial and Trust Management, and Riverview Wealth Management -- operate local community offices and proudly offer the best in personalized services to businesses and individuals in Berks, Blair, Centre, Clearfield, Dauphin, Huntingdon, Lebanon, Lycoming, Northumberland, Perry, Schuylkill and Somerset counties and surrounding areas.  
  
Our professional advisory division, Riverview Wealth Management, provides top-notch investment advisory services and brokered transactions through Cetera Investment Services LLC, a full service registered broker/dealer, as well as traditional Trust services through its wholly-owned trust division, CBT Financial & Trust Management.  
  
Riverview Bank has roots dating back to December of 1900, when Halifax National Bank was founded in Halifax, PA. In 2008, Halifax National Bank joined with First National Bank of Marysville (founded in 1904) to form Riverview Bank. Riverview Bank expanded its presence in Schuylkill County in 2013 with the acquisition of Union Bank and Trust and into Somerset County in 2015 with the acquisition of Citizens National Bank of Meyersdale, now known as Citizens Neighborhood Bank. In 2017, Riverview expanded into Blair, Centre, Clearfield, and Huntingdon counties and added another 13 branch offices when it acquired CBT Bank as its newest division. With a keen focus on the communities we serve, Riverview combines a tradition of friendly, attentive service with 21st Century know-how. Stop in and visit one of our convenient branches today and discover the many benefits of Hometown Banking.

The firm’s AMP (Accessibility Management Platform) delivers a scalable infrastructure to manage accessibility across the entire development life cycle. Level Access's solutions meet the complex and changing demands of enterprise class organizations and include a suite of services to assist clients beginning compliance initiatives. The firm is known as the complete solution for accessibility compliance issues, earning numerous industry accolades reflecting its breadth and depth of expertise, strategic focus and superior customer service. Who is the CEO of MOLOCO?

.

Who are the decision makers in MOLOCO?

What services does Moloco offer to enhance digital advertising strategies?

Moloco specializes in programmatic advertising solutions powered by advanced machine learning algorithms. Our services include a demand-side platform (DSP) that allows businesses to optimize their ad spend across various channels. We provide tools for real-time bidding, audience targeting, and performance analytics, enabling companies to maximize their return on investment (ROI) in digital advertising.

How does Moloco utilize machine learning in its advertising solutions?

At Moloco, we leverage machine learning to analyze vast amounts of data and predict user behavior. Our algorithms continuously learn from campaign performance, allowing us to optimize ad placements and targeting strategies in real-time. This results in more effective advertising campaigns that can adapt to changing market conditions and improve overall performance.

Which industries can benefit from Moloco's performance solutions?

Moloco's performance solutions are designed to support a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, gaming, travel, and finance. Any business looking to enhance its digital marketing efforts and improve ROI can benefit from our machine learning-driven advertising solutions. Our technology is particularly effective for companies that rely on data-driven strategies to reach their target audiences.

What is a demand-side platform (DSP), and how does Moloco's DSP stand out?

A demand-side platform (DSP) is a technology that allows advertisers to purchase ad space in an automated fashion across multiple ad exchanges. Moloco's DSP stands out due to its integration of machine learning capabilities, which optimize bidding strategies and audience targeting. This ensures that advertisers can reach the right users at the right time, maximizing the effectiveness of their campaigns while minimizing costs.

Can Moloco help businesses with retail media advertising?

Yes, Moloco provides solutions tailored for retail media advertising. Our platform enables retailers to leverage their first-party data to create targeted advertising campaigns that drive sales both online and in-store. By utilizing machine learning, we help retailers optimize their ad placements and improve customer engagement, ultimately leading to increased revenue.

How can businesses measure the success of their campaigns using Moloco's solutions?

Businesses can measure the success of their campaigns through Moloco's comprehensive analytics dashboard, which provides insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as click-through rates, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS). Our platform also offers real-time reporting and A/B testing capabilities, allowing advertisers to make data-driven decisions and continuously optimize their campaigns for better results.

Eazypower has grown to provide the largest selection of Screwdriver tips in the industry, consistently outperforming the competition. Eazypower Products are exported around the world to Latin America, Australia, New Zealand, Germany, Ireland, United Kingdom, Sweden, Canada, Iceland, Israel, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and Africa.  
  
Eazypower's Industrial Quality line, competitive pricing, consistently high level of service and creativeness. Eazypower Corporation makes its home in Chicago, in a 108,000 square foot Manufacturing Plant and warehouse.

About Primera Africa Group Limited
----------------------------------

About Primera Africa  
Primera Africa is a company with a fresh outlook on today's complex markets, with an understanding of the interactions between the numerous nations on the African continent. We offer a wide variety of investment opportunities and research that aim to provide our clients with the most in-depth analyses and investment strategies to aid their decision making process.  
  
Business Units  
Financial Advisory - Our Financial Advisory business provides strategic advice in connection with a wide range of financial and business objectives to assist our clients meet their goals.  
  
Securities Trading - The Securities Trading business operates as a broker/dealer on the floor of the Nigerian Stock Exchange ("NSE"). Our activities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter equity and fixed income instruments.  
  
Principal Investments - We actively seek out investment opportunities on the continent to enable us invest through our in-house fund. Our approach is to examine mid-size companies with significant potential and partner with them to help them realise their objectives.  
  
Consumer Lending - Our consumer lending (Primera Credit) is licensed to operate as Bright-End Microfinance Bank Limited by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It seeks to provide fast and flexible personalised loans, in the most professional, efficient and transparent manner to meet each of our customers’ needs.  
  
Corporate Strategy  
Our vision is to be the preferred financial services firm for clients seeking to transact on the African continent. We believe our international expertise combined with our local knowledge creates a strong competitive advantage for the client and the firm.  
  
Our mission is to be a distinctive financial services firm driven by our commitment to our core principles and values going beyond established limits and surpassing others through sustained performance and superior thinking.

Our facilities include Highland Hospital, a regional trauma center and teaching hospital, John George Psychiatric Hospital, an acute and emergency care facility, Fairmont Hospital, an acute rehabilitation hospital and skilled nursing facility, longtime community-based hospitals San Leandro Hospital and Alameda Hospital and four neighborhood-based community Wellness Centers located in Oakland, Newark and Hayward.

About Australian Institute Of Fitness
-------------------------------------

The Australian Institute of Fitness (AIF), headquartered at 87 Marsden Street, Parramatta, NSW, is the largest fitness training provider in Australia, renowned for its comprehensive and dynamic training programs. AIF specializes in offering a variety of study options, including full-time, part-time, and online courses in Fitness, Massage, and Nutrition, catering to the diverse needs of aspiring fitness professionals. With modern campuses strategically located across Australia, AIF provides students with access to state-of-the-art facilities and resources.  
  
One of the standout features of AIF is its commitment to student success, exemplified by its dedicated Careers Scouts and unique initiatives like Fitness Industry Recruitment Expos (F.I.R.E Nights) and Campus-Direct Presentations. These resources significantly enhance students' chances of securing rewarding positions in the fitness industry upon graduation. The institute prides itself on delivering high-quality education led by experienced instructors, making it essential for prospective students to explore the Australian Institute of Fitness teachers list to understand the expertise and qualifications of those who will guide their learning journey.  
  
At AIF, the philosophy is clear: to be your best, you must train with the best. This commitment to excellence is reflected in the success stories of its graduates, who go on to thrive in various roles within the fitness sector. For anyone looking to embark on a fulfilling career in fitness, nutrition, or massage therapy, AIF stands out as the premier choice. To learn more or to get started on your journey, call AIF today at 1300 669 669 or visit their website at www.fitness.edu.au. RTO ID: 121508.

About Henry Stewart Events
--------------------------

Henry Stewart Events is the only producer of dedicated, cross-industry Digital Asset Management (DAM) events and webinars – all from the user’s perspective. We are committed to covering the latest thinking and developments in the management of digital media and to providing guidance for organizations considering the implementation of a DAM system. Increasingly DAM is becoming a must-have component of enterprise content management systems.  
  
Attended by hundreds of delegates and sponsors, the Henry Stewart DAM events hosted in New York, London, and Los Angeles are the premier destinations for DAM users who need to know about current happenings and future trends in the industry. All participants, including executives considering their organization’s first steps into DAM, will benefit from the content-packed programs and case studies presented by world leading experts. DAM has become an essential business function, and effective DAM provides cost savings, improved productivity, consistent brand management and increased revenue, profits and shareholder value.  
  
Our DAM community ranges from professionals managing global DAM operations with numerous staff worldwide to a new museum with a part time DAM manager. All can contribute useful insights as we forge ahead in this ‘digital’ revolution. We thrive on collective knowledge and exchanging information at these events benefits everyone. Insights from panel sessions, case studies and a chance conversation during a break may all yield answers.  
  
Henry Stewart also offers a leading range of Creative Operations conferences. In increasing numbers, successful organizations across all product and service sectors are recognizing the importance of ‘creative operations’— the tools, systems, and methods that maximize the productivity of ‘creative staff’. What was considered a back office function is now credited as a key driver in producing great creative work.  
  
We hope you can join us soon!

What types of information security solutions does FishNet Security offer?

FishNet Security provides a comprehensive range of information security solutions, including risk assessments, compliance management, incident response, and managed security services. Our offerings are designed to help organizations identify vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. We also specialize in security technology integration, ensuring that your existing systems work together effectively to enhance your overall security posture.

How does FishNet Security assist organizations in managing their security risks?

FishNet Security employs a systematic approach to risk management. We begin with a thorough risk assessment to identify potential vulnerabilities and threats within your environment. Based on this assessment, we work with you to develop a tailored security strategy that includes implementing the right technologies, policies, and training programs. Our team also provides ongoing support and monitoring to adapt to evolving threats and ensure continuous improvement in your security posture.

What industries does FishNet Security serve?

FishNet Security serves a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, government, education, and retail. Each industry has unique security challenges and regulatory requirements, and our team has the expertise to address these specific needs. Does FishNet Security provide training for employees on security best practices?

By empowering your staff with knowledge, we help you create a culture of security within your organization, reducing the likelihood of human error leading to security breaches.

What is managed security, and how can it benefit my organization?

Managed security refers to the outsourcing of your organization's security functions to a specialized provider like FishNet Security. This service includes continuous monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management. By leveraging our expertise and advanced technologies, your organization can benefit from enhanced security without the need to maintain a large in-house security team. This allows you to focus on your core business activities while ensuring that your security needs are met effectively.

How can I get started with FishNet Security's services?

The Alaska Native Heritage Center (ANHC), one of America's Cultural Treasures, preserves & strengthens the traditions, languages, & art of Alaska’s Native Peoples.

About Daybreak Community Services, Inc.
---------------------------------------

Daybreak was formed with the commitment to provide supports and services for people with disabilities. Our guiding values are the foundation of Daybreak: a foundation built to foster an environment where all are encouraged to make and achieve their own personal dreams.  
  
Services are tailored through Person-Directed planning to enhance the personal strengths of each individual, enabling each to live and work successfully in the community they choose. Our goal at Daybreak is to ensure that all people supported through Daybreak services have the opportunities they choose and cherish.  
  
Daybreak now operates HCS waiver and ICF/ID group homes as well as providing services in individual‘s own homes, foster care settings and day habilitation sites. Services to people throughout Texas are currently provided by Daybreak through the ICF/ID, HCS, Texas Home Living, and Deaf/Blind Multi-disability Medicaid Waivers, and through private pay and third-party contract payers. Throughout the state, services are developed under the direction of individuals with extensive backgrounds in Developmental Disability programs.

=============================

About Neighborhood Defender Service
-----------------------------------

Neighborhood Defender Service (NDS) is known nationally and internationally for its innovative, community-based, holistic public defense practice. Our dedicated staff is committed to providing unparalleled legal representation.  
  
Since we opened our doors in Harlem in 1990, we have pioneered the holistic model as a way to address problems plaguing public defense. In contrast to a traditional public defense practice, NDS clients have an entire team fighting on their behalf, including criminal and civil attorneys, family defense attorneys, advocates, social workers, investigators, paralegals, law school and social work interns, and pro bono attorneys. NDS deploys all of these resources on behalf of our clients, addressing the underlying issues that bring them into contact with the criminal legal system. NDS staff use their engagement with a client as an opportunity to disentangle them from the system completely.  
  
This approach allows defense to extend well beyond the courtroom, with robust social services and comprehensive teams meant to protect our clients from the damages of criminal legal proceedings. When clients face consequences with employment, schooling, immigration or in family or housing court, NDS works alongside them to resolve these issues.  
  
NDS fights for our clients both by working their cases and by advocating for policy changes that provide a measure of justice to their communities. NDS is an active member of these communities, establishing meaningful relationships with clients and their families. NDS hosts frequent education and outreach events to support its neighbors and participate in local events.  
  
NDS has been a part of the Harlem community for nearly 30 years and opened a second office in Detroit in 2019, providing the same world-class service to the people of Wayne County.

Our holistic approach ensures that we address not only the legal issues at hand but also the underlying social factors that may affect our clients' lives.

How does NDS approach holistic defense?

NDS employs a holistic defense model that integrates legal representation with social services. This means that in addition to providing legal counsel, our team works to connect clients with resources such as mental health support, housing assistance, and employment services. This comprehensive approach aims to improve clients' overall well-being and reduce recidivism.

Who is eligible for the services provided by NDS?

NDS primarily serves individuals who are facing criminal charges and cannot afford private legal representation. We also assist clients in immigration matters, civil issues, family law, and housing disputes. Eligibility is typically based on income level and the nature of the legal issue. Interested individuals should contact NDS directly for more information on eligibility criteria.

What should I expect during my first meeting with an NDS attorney?

During your first meeting with an NDS attorney, you can expect a thorough intake process where we will gather information about your legal situation. The attorney will listen to your concerns, explain the legal process, and discuss potential strategies for your case. This initial meeting is also an opportunity for you to ask questions and understand how NDS can support you.

How does NDS support clients facing immigration issues?

NDS provides comprehensive immigration defense services, including representation for individuals facing deportation, assistance with asylum applications, and help with obtaining legal status. Our team is dedicated to navigating the complexities of immigration law and advocating for the rights of our clients, ensuring they receive fair treatment throughout the legal process.

Can NDS help with housing-related legal issues?

Yes, NDS offers housing defense services to assist clients facing eviction, landlord disputes, and other housing-related legal challenges. Our attorneys work to protect tenants' rights and ensure that individuals and families have access to safe and stable housing. We also collaborate with community organizations to provide additional support and resources for housing stability.

His diplomatic skills and natural charm have made him an effective ambassador for the United Kingdom, earning him the respect and admiration of world leaders and citizens alike.  
  
Looking to the future, Prince William's role in the royal family is set to become even more significant as he prepares to eventually ascend to the throne. His dedication to his duties, his compassion for others, and his commitment to making a positive impact on society all bode well for the future of the monarchy. About Atlantic Pacific Lines
----------------------------

Atlantic Pacific Lines, headquartered in West Long Branch, New Jersey, is a leading Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) with over 75 years of expertise in international ocean shipping. Founded on the principles of reliability and dependability, the company has carved a niche in the global shipping community by providing exceptional service tailored to meet the diverse needs of its clients. Atlantic Pacific Lines excels in coordinating, shipping, tracking, and securing the delivery of cargo for both inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring a seamless logistics experience.  
  
The company offers a wide array of services, including Less than Container Load (LCL) and Full Container Load (FCL) shipping, Break Bulk, Project Cargo, and Roll-On/Roll-Off (RO-RO) transport. With a strong focus on competitive rates, particularly for routes to the Middle East, Indian Subcontinent, West Africa, Europe, Mediterranean, Far East, and Australia, Atlantic Pacific Lines is well-equipped to handle all INCO Terms and Tariffs. Their comprehensive service portfolio also includes AES/Shipper's Export Declaration, AMS & ISF filing, customs clearance, and the issuance of Certificates of Origin, ensuring compliance with international shipping regulations.  
  
In addition to ocean freight, Atlantic Pacific Lines provides intermodal services to meet road and rail requirements, as well as a variety of air freight options. The company is committed to safeguarding valuable goods through cargo insurance and offers specialized refrigerated and temperature-controlled containers for perishable items. With an extensive global network of agents, Atlantic Pacific Lines is dedicated to delivering personalized, economical, and reliable international shipping solutions that exceed customer expectations. For businesses seeking to enhance their logistics operations, Atlantic Pacific Lines stands ready to provide unparalleled support and expertise.

About Paradigm Precision
------------------------

Our manufacturing of gas turbine components for aerospace, marine and power generation can be summed up with one word: Precision.  
  
Paradigm Precision is a leading manufacturer of complex machined and fabricated components for the aerospace, land-based power generation and marine markets. Our core capabilities include laser services, airflow measurement, thermal coatings, electrical discharge machining, precision machining and TCT BLAST™.  
  
Paradigm Precision adds value by leveraging the synergy between capital investments, engineering, low-cost manufacturing operations and modern manufacturing methods. Guided by seasoned leadership, the company's culture is focused on customer requirements and the principles of LEAN and Six Sigma operations.  
  
A Worldwide Presence  
Paradigm Precision was established in 2011 and is a privately owned enterprise formed by the acquisition of Turbo Combustor Technology, Paradigm Precision Holdings, and Unison Engine Components (3 locations).  
  
The Company operates on a global basis and is sponsored by the Carlyle Group and AeroEquity.

### Frequently Asked Questions about VidSummit

Who are the decision makers in VidSummit?

The decision makers in VidSummit are [Caitlyn Johnston](https://contactout.com/Caitlyn-Johnston-9830146)
, Colony Jolley, [Derral Eves](https://contactout.com/Derral-Eves-82910899)

What is VidSummit and what services do you offer?

VidSummit is a premier conference focused on video marketing, content creation, and online business growth. We offer a variety of services including workshops, keynote speeches from industry leaders, networking opportunities, and access to exclusive resources aimed at helping creators and businesses enhance their video strategies and reach their target audiences effectively.

Who should attend VidSummit?

VidSummit is designed for a diverse audience including content creators, marketers, entrepreneurs, and business owners who are looking to leverage video as a powerful tool for growth. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, VidSummit provides valuable insights and strategies to elevate your video marketing efforts.

What topics are covered at VidSummit?

At VidSummit, we cover a wide range of topics related to video marketing, including video production techniques, audience engagement strategies, monetization methods, social media marketing, and the latest trends in video technology. Our sessions are led by industry experts who share their insights and experiences to help attendees succeed.

How can I network with other attendees at VidSummit?

Networking is a key component of VidSummit. We provide various opportunities for attendees to connect, including dedicated networking sessions, interactive workshops, and social events. Additionally, our online platform allows participants to connect before, during, and after the event, facilitating meaningful relationships and collaborations.

Are there any resources available for attendees after the event?

Yes, attendees of VidSummit gain access to a wealth of resources even after the event concludes. This includes recorded sessions, presentation slides, and exclusive content from speakers. We also provide a community platform where attendees can continue discussions, share insights, and collaborate on projects long after the conference ends.

Geistlich Sons Ltd are the UK affiliate for Geistlich Pharma AG, who produce and distribute medical devices and drugs (anti-infectives, vitamins) for regenerative medicine at the Wolhusen and Root sites in central Switzerland. For 30 years, Geistlich Biomaterials has been the undisputed No. 1 in regenerative dentistry. The excellent results of guided bone regeneration with Geistlich Bio-Oss® and Geistlich Bio-Gide®, are largely due to their unsurpassed biofunctionality. The products are perfectly suited to combined use: Geistlich Bio-Oss® forming the scaffold for the in-growing blood vessels and bone-forming osteoblasts. Whilst Geistlich Bio-Gide® provides an optimal barrier, shielding the young bone from the surrounding connective tissue cells and supporting wound healing. Geistlich Bio-Oss® Collagen and the Geistlich Bio-Oss® Pen provide superior handling options, further enhancing the range from the worldwide No.1 supplier of biomaterials.

About Inktomi Corporation
-------------------------

Inktomi Corporation was founded in 1996, went public on the NASDAQ (INKT) in 2008 and was acquired by Yahoo! in 2003. Inktomi's core technology was born out of US DARPA funded research on massively paralleled systems. The company's original focus was on large scale Internet search, providing private-labeled search services to some of the world's best known search engines including Yahoo!, Microsoft, AOL and others. Inktomi later introduced high-end network cacheing software, sold primarily to telecom and internet service providers, to dramatically improve the performance of web-based network traffic. After re-focussing the company on web search and related advertising, Yahoo! acquired the company in 2003.

Boston's Next Big Thing in Healthy Food, 6AM Health Delivers Fresh and Healthy Food to Your Office!

Q. What are Fresh Fridges?  
  
A. Think of our fridges as the freshest vending machines you’ve never seen – dispensing crisp salads, cold-pressed juices, and nutritious bowls with just the touch of a screen.  
  
Q. Okay, how fresh are we talking here?  
  
A. Let’s put it this way: all of our items are handcrafted locally and restocked daily. From our kitchen to the tip of your taste buds counted in hours, never in days.  
  
Q. How does this news impact me?  
  
A. As our Fresh Fridges start popping up around the area, picking up fresh, local, grab-and-go food is about to get easier than ever. In other words? Healthy eating is about to get easier than ever!Whether you're a commuter, an on-the-go Mom or Dad, a student, or - really - a busy anyone looking to snag a quick, nutritious meal...we've got your back.  
  
Q. Where's the closest Fresh Fridge to me?  
  
A. We're growing quickly! So to keep on top of our latest locations, follow us here, on Instagram or at our site. Or, maybe you want to place a fridge? Message us!  
  
Q. Hey wait, who are you guys anyway?  
  
A. Actually, many of you may know us already. Since 2017, we've been delivering a week’s worth of healthy meals to the doorsteps of our Greater Bostonian customers every Monday before 6AM.The thing is - as our business has grown it's become clear that, logistically, doorstep deliveries alone could never have the kind of impact we want to make on the world.  
Enter: Fresh Fridges.Our goal remains the same, to make it easier for people to create healthier habits by making fresh, nutritious food more accessible than ever before. But now, our community is no longer limited to one delivery per week. Now, we can start to be everywhere you are - so you can grab a healthy meal anytime you want.

About Bahrain Airport Services
------------------------------

Bahrain Airport Services \[BAS\] was founded in 1977 to provide fully integrated airport services at Bahrain International Airport. Supported by a human capital of approximately 3000 staff, BAS is an ISAGO accredited Ground Service Provider which owns and operates four distinct business units.  
  
1\. Airport & Ground Operations: Our Operations division has a handling capacity of 8 million passengers annually. It currently serves 36 regional and international airlines providing a comprehensive range of ground handling services including passenger and ramp handling, dispatch and aircraft load control, special services, baggage handling, etc.  
  
2\. Cargo Services: Our Cargo division handles 125,000 tonnes of freight annually including import, export and trans-shipment. The Cargo Terminal encompasses an area of 19,000 square meters with a multi-bay storage racking warehouse and a range of special facilities for perishables, valuables, dangerous goods and livestock.  
  
3\. Catering Services: The modern In-Flight Catering infrastructure covers an area of approximately 11,000 square meters and has a maximum production capacity of 35,000 meals daily. An average of 500,000 meals per month is currently produced to satisfy 125 different menus and provide seamless transport “from-production-to-aircraft”.  
  
4\. Aircraft Maintenance Services: Provides line maintenance, technical certification and troubleshooting under EASA Part-145 Maintenance Organization Approval. It handles a total of 8,000 aircraft maintenance movements annually.  
  
BAS also operates a fully owned subsidiary, BAS Aircraft Engineering Training Centre \[BAETC\]: www.baetc.org.

Today, we are a global business-to-business agri-products supplier to consumer product manufacturers, that sources and processes leaf tobacco and plant-based ingredients. Through our plant-based ingredients platform, we provide a variety of value-added manufacturing processes to produce high-quality, specialty vegetable- and fruit-based ingredients as well as botanical extracts and flavorings for human and pet food end markets. Universal conducts business in more than 30 countries on five continents and employs over 25,000 permanent and seasonal workers. About Creative Plan Designs, Ltd.
---------------------------------

WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO?  
  
One thing we do better than anyone else is understand the complexities of the retirement plan arena. We weave our knowledge of what the laws say (and don't say) into a tapestry with the elements of estate planning and taxation that naturally interact and come into play at this time in one's life.  
  
We are known for solving the most complicated and convoluted of retirement plan problems. We would like to be thought of as an alternative before the plan suffers near fatal complications.  
  
In some ways, we must describe what we do by contrasting it to what we do not do. Although this is a slippery slope to transverse and avoid the appearance of engaging in negative selling, it may offer the most succinct explanation of what sets us apart.  
  
We do not receive asset gathering fees from investment houses and as such, owe them no loyalty. Our only loyalty is to our clients. We do not serve two masters. All our compensation is above board and disclosed. Our compensation is not increased when a client's retirement portfolio increases in value.  
  
All plan administrators are credentialed in the retirement planning field by recognized organizations. Never, ever does an unskilled clerk or foreign national have any sway over a CPD plan.  
  
Our firm is CEFEX certified. This attests that we meet and maintain the highest level of fiduciary responsibility for each and every CPD client.

About MAB Community Services
----------------------------

MAB Community Services specializes in individualized rehabilitation, and family-focused strategies that help individuals with a range of disabilities live full and independent lives in the community. MAB’s mission is to work with individuals with disabilities to eliminate barriers and create opportunities. Our experience allows us to forge strong community partnerships so that we can meet the pressing need for high quality services and programs and transform lives.  
Our Divisions Are:  
The Massachusetts Association for the Blind and Visually Impaired provides vision rehabilitation and support services throughout Massachusetts to more than 1,200 adults who are blind or visually impaired. Programs include access to low vision clinics, peer empowerment support groups, one-to-one volunteer assistance, in-home vision rehabilitation, adjustment counseling/mental health support, and access technology training. Our unique blend of programs and services enables individuals to learn to live confidently with vision loss.  
MAB Adult Disability Services provides residential support services, individual support, transitional assistance, and social, vocational, and recreational day programming for individuals with developmental disabilities or brain injuries in Greater Boston and Central Massachusetts. The division operates more than 25 group homes and serves over 300 people each year.  
The Ivy Street School is a special education residential and day high school for neurodivergent youth. We work with students to prepare them for adulthood with the tools they need to achieve their greatest independence. Using a lens of disability justice, we support the whole child through a student-first model driven by a commitment to knowing our students well. Additionally, through our Skills for Life program, we support in-home skill development for young adults.  
  
We're Hiring! See our current openings at www.mabcommunity.org/mab-community-careers/

Laurent Blanc, the legendary French football manager, has had an illustrious career both as a player and a coach. Known for his elegance and composure on the field, Blanc has seamlessly transitioned into a successful managerial role, where he has continued to showcase his expertise and leadership capabilities.  
  
Blanc began his football career as a central defender, playing for top clubs such as Montpellier, Napoli, Barcelona, Marseille, Inter Milan, and Manchester United. Renowned for his defensive abilities, aerial prowess, and precise passing, Blanc quickly established himself as a force to be reckoned with on the field. His impressive performances and natural leadership skills earned him the nickname "Le Président" during his time at Marseille, where he captained the team to victory in the French league and the UEFA Champions League.  
  
After retiring as a player, Blanc transitioned into coaching, where he excelled just as he did on the field. His first major managerial role came with Bordeaux in 2007, where he guided the team to an unexpected Ligue 1 title in the 2008-2009 season. Blanc's tactical astuteness, ability to motivate players, and strategic planning played a pivotal role in Bordeaux's success, solidifying his reputation as a top-class manager.  
  
Blanc's success at Bordeaux earned him the opportunity to manage the French national team in 2010. As the head coach, Blanc brought a new sense of unity and discipline to the team, instilling a strong work ethic and a winning mentality. Under his guidance, the French national team achieved notable victories and reached the quarter-finals of the Euro 2012. Blanc's ability to bring out the best in his players and his strategic approach earned him widespread acclaim and respect in the footballing world.  
  
In 2012, Blanc took on another major challenge as he was appointed as the manager of Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), one of the most prestigious clubs in Europe. His tenure at PSG was marked by unprecedented success, as he led the team to multiple Ligue 1 titles and domestic cup victories. Blanc's meticulous approach to tactics, emphasis on teamwork, and focus on player development were instrumental in PSG's dominance in domestic competitions, cementing his legacy as one of the most successful managers in the club's history.  
  
Blanc's tenure at PSG also saw the team make significant strides in European competitions, with memorable victories over top teams and memorable performances in the UEFA Champions League. His ability to orchestrate the team's attacking prowess while maintaining defensive solidity showcased his versatility and strategic insight as a manager. Under Blanc's leadership, PSG emerged as a formidable force in European football, earning praise for their stylish and effective playing style.  
  
Blanc's impact on the footballing world extends beyond his managerial achievements. His dedication to promoting fair play, sportsmanship, and the development of young talent has earned him admiration and respect from players, fans, and fellow coaches. Blanc's commitment to upholding the values of the game while striving for excellence has set a powerful example for the next generation of football leaders.  
  
In addition to his coaching prowess, Blanc's charismatic personality and composed demeanor have made him a highly respected figure in the footballing community. His ability to inspire and lead by example has endeared him to fans and players alike, further solidifying his status as a revered figure in the world of football.  
  
Blanc's contributions to the sport of football have left an enduring legacy, earning him a place among the all-time greats of the game. His remarkable journey from a talented player to an exceptional manager reflects his unwavering passion, dedication, and remarkable aptitude for the sport. By taking the time to understand your needs, we become partners in the success of your business and personal financial goals. We’re also proud to partner with our neighbors to improve the quality of life for our community. With our roots as a community bank, we proudly support local business and workforce initiatives in the areas we serve, in addition to numerous civic groups, charitable organizations and youth educational programs.

Many businesses claim to do this, few can truly deliver. About Westminster Forum Projects
--------------------------------

Westminster Forum Projects (WFP) operates a group of influential, impartial and cross-party forums in public policy. Our mission is to facilitate the formulation of 'best' public policy by providing policymakers and implementers, and those with an interest in the issues, with a sense of the way different stakeholder perspectives interrelate. Usually this is through impartially-framed, inclusive discussion conducted either in public or under the Chatham House Rule.  
  
All the Westminster Forum Projects forums enjoy substantial support and involvement from key policymakers within UK and devolved legislatures, governments and regulatory bodies and from stakeholders in professional bodies, businesses and their advisors, consumer organisations, local government representatives, and other interested groups. The forums organise senior-level seminars on a wide range of public policy areas. None of the forums has a policy agenda of its own, other than simply to raise the quality of debate on public policy developments and so create opportunities for informed discussion.

About Companhia De Electricidade De Macau, CEM - SA
---------------------------------------------------

Companhia de Electricidade de Macau (CEM) description and an introduction of the Macao Power System:  
(Update of 2012.07.20)  
The territory of Macao covers an area of around 29.2km2 including Macao peninsula, Taipa and Coloane islands. It is mainly composed of high density residential areas and large scale tourism with gambling business. Due to rapid growth in recent years from large scale casino complexes, a large increase in energy growth was recorded. Currently, the Macao high voltage power transmission system contains 3 different voltage levels: 220kV, 110kV, 66kV. The network has one 220/110kV substation, four 110/66/11kV substations and eighteen 66/11kV substations. There are three 220kV interconnection circuits, each rated 350MVA.  
  
The total gross energy consumption of 2011 was 4,002GWh. The amount of electricity imported from mainland China was 3,163GWh, accounting for 79% of total electricity consumption. The power peak demand of 2011 was 725MW.  
  
At the end of 2011, CEM was providing services to 224,796 customers, and the CEM’s sales for 2011 totaled 3,803GWh.

About Canada Pooch Ltd.
-----------------------

We are designers of high quality, fashionable and functional pet outerwear and accessories located in Toronto, Canada. Helping your pooch brave the rain and cold in style is what we do best. Everything we do at Canada Pooch is guided by 3 main principles:  
  
1\. Your pup should be at least as stylish as you are, maybe more!  
  
2\. Function first – your pup needs to feel warm, comfortable and dry  
  
3\. Your pet deserves top quality fabrics and craftsmanship  
  
Whether your pooch’s schedule includes rigorous rural hikes, play sessions in the park, or casual city walks, our range of styles ensures versatility and the utmost protection. We obsess over every detail – just ask our resident product testing pooch, Bella the puggle. She inspires us every day to get down on all fours and sniff out life as a dog (that’s how we developed the comfiest cosiest dog coats around)!  
  
There’s no denying the adorable charm of our product line, but it is the craftsmanship and functionality of Canada Pooch products that set us apart from the rest. We truly love animals, and strive to develop innovative, forward-thinking products that guarantee a positive experience for dogs and owners alike. Canada Pooch apparel and accessories do not contain any animal products. No down. No fur. No leather.  
  
See you at the park!

About Coldwell Banker Residential Brokerage
-------------------------------------------

NRT is the largest residential real estate brokerage company in the nation and 12th largest corporate-owned commercial brokerage. NRT and its affiliated companies, marketing partners and joint ventures provides mortgage, title, insurance, escrow, warranty, relocation and concierge services to NRT's family of companies. We own and operate companies in more than 35 of the nation’s largest metropolitan markets, with approximately 800 sales offices, 5,700 employees and 48,000 sales associates in our extended family. Our companies do business under the world-renowned Coldwell Banker®, Coldwell Banker Commercial®, ERA®, Sotheby's International Realty® and The Corcoran Group® brand names. By any national measure of real estate success, we are the industry leader. Nearly all of our local companies are ranked No. 1 in their respective markets. In 2008, NRT posted more than $131 billion in closed sales volume. NRT’s market success is no accident. Looking beyond the numbers, the NRT story begins with our people. The hallmark of our company is the remarkable dedication that our people bring to our mission of "creating exceptional real estate experiences for our customers and communities through the passionate delivery of truly remarkable service." We are proud to have a senior management team with decades of unmatched experience in the most successful real estate companies around the country. Likewise, our sales associates and support team are second to none. For NRT, this combination of great companies and great people has resulted in innovative ideas, valuable synergies and above all, a service-oriented culture.

About City of Worthington
-------------------------

Worthington is a strong suburban community in the vibrant Columbus, Ohio region, ideally located at the northern crossroads of I-270, I-71 & SR 315, with easy access to, from and around the central Ohio region.  
  
History  
The earliest planned community in Ohio, Worthington was settled in 1803. Early leaders purchased 16,000 acres of land and planned the layout for the village. Worthington was platted as a New England-type village around a central public square, which was designated for religious and educational purposes, as well as a spot for community gatherings. This area remains today as our Village Green and still maintains the values of Worthington’s founders, while also anchoring one of Central Ohio’s most iconic downtown historic districts.  
  
Worthington Today  
Today Worthington remains committed to thoughtful planning and development. As a mature community, the focus is on planned redevelopment of existing properties and land. Worthington includes a mix of unique retail establishments and restaurants in our historic Old Worthington district, office and professional businesses in the Wilson Bridge Road and High Street corridors, and industrial and office in our Huntley Road corridor.  
  
For more information, please contact Assistant City Manager David McCorkle at (614) 436-4518, email [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

About Bandhan Bank
------------------

Bandhan Bank Limited, headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, is a dynamic financial institution that was incorporated on December 23, 2014, as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bandhan Financial Holdings Limited. With roots in the microfinance sector, Bandhan Bank aims to bridge the gap in financial services for underserved communities across urban, semi-urban, and rural areas. The bank commenced its journey with a robust capital base of ₹2,570 crore, which has since grown to ₹3,334 crore as of March 31, 2016, reflecting a strong capital adequacy ratio of over 29.01%.  
  
As of June 30, 2023, Bandhan Bank operates more than 6,100 banking outlets nationwide, serving over 3.07 crore customers. The bank has successfully mobilized deposits amounting to ₹1,08,479 crore and has total advances of ₹1,03,168 crore, culminating in a total business of ₹2,11,647 crore. With a dedicated workforce of 72,000 employees, Bandhan Bank offers a diverse range of financial products and services, including savings accounts, personal loans, microloans, and various retail banking solutions.  
  
The bank is committed to financial inclusion, guided by its philosophy of ‘Aapka Bhala, Sabki Bhalai’ (Your Welfare is Everyone’s Welfare). By leveraging technology and innovative banking practices, Bandhan Bank not only meets the financial needs of its customers but also fosters better education, healthcare, and self-employment opportunities. With a focus on serving those overlooked by traditional banking systems, Bandhan Bank stands as a beacon of hope and empowerment in the Indian banking landscape.

Founded in 2010, CRScube Inc. is a provider of SaaS eClinical solutions software. Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, CRScube also maintains a global presence in Gaithersburg, Maryland, and Tokyo, Japan with plans to expand into the Chinese, European, and Australian markets. CRScube staff includes various experts within the field of clinical operations and software development. As a result, CRScube is the first eClinical solutions company in Asia to become an SCDM CCDM Industry Partner. As a whole, our mission is to advance the clinical research process by means of better end-to-end eClinical software.  
  
cubeSolutions currently comprises of nine in-house developed eClinical solutions. Owing to their modularity in design, each product can be used either as a standalone product or as part of a larger integrated system. None require any on-site installations as they are all web-based and operate on a cloud platform. All have been built to deliver to our clients enhanced levels of efficiency and data integrity via automation, streamlined collaboration, and real-time visibility metrics and reports. All cubeSolutions are compliant with 21 CFR part 11.  
  
cubeSolutions, as of 2023, have been used in over 4,000 trials and research studies of varying phases and therapeutic areas. Our client list is made up of 550+ pharma companies. 145+ CROs, and 14 AROs. On our EDC (cubeCDMS) more than 1,200,000 subjects have been registered by more than 58,000 researchers, at site locations in more than 20 countries.  
  
For more information, please visit our website at www.crscube.io or feel free to contact us with any questions you may have and to schedule a demo!

About Trinchero Family Estates
------------------------------

The world’s second-largest family-owned winery and fourth-largest overall, Trinchero Family Estates (TFE) comprises more than 50 award-winning wine and spirits brands distributed in more than  
50 countries around the globe. Founded in 1948—when Italian immigrant Mario Trinchero brought his young family from New York City to Napa Valley and purchased an abandoned Prohibition-era winery called Sutter Home in St. Helena—Trinchero Family Estates has been an innovator for seven decades.  
  
Today, Trinchero Family Estates remains deeply rooted in Napa Valley, encompassing a broad portfolio of global offerings, including flagship brands Sutter Home Family Vineyards and Ménage à Trois; luxury brands Trinchero Napa Valley and Napa Cellars; partner brands Joel Gott Wines, Bieler Père et Fils, Charles & Charles and Neyers Vineyards; import brands San Polo, Famiglia Cotarella, Ceretto, Tenuta Regaleali, Angove Family Winemakers, Avissi, Echo Bay, Finca Allende and Terras Gauda; and Spirits and Specialty Beverage brands Del Mar, Hanson of Sonoma Organic Vodka, Tres Agaves Organic Tequila, Tres Agaves Organic Cocktail Mixers, Amador Whiskey and Trincheri Vermouth.  
  
Headquartered in Napa Valley for more than 70 years, Trinchero Family Estates is comprised of more than 1,100 team members, five northern California tasting rooms and numerous California wineries. Trinchero Family Estates’ production facilities span Trinchero Central Coast to the south, Main Street winery and Luxury Winemakers’ Studio to the north, and Westside winery and Terra d’Oro to the east. Learn more at www.tfewines.com.

Anna Kern Towson is a seasoned health communication professional with over 12 years of experience, currently serving as a Public Affairs Specialist in the Office of the Director at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). She oversees the agency's social media presence across platforms such as Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), LinkedIn, and Instagram, ensuring that complex health and science information is translated into accessible messages that resonate with diverse audiences.  
  
One of Anna's key projects involves the development of dynamic content for the Director’s X account, where she not only curates informative posts but also recommends innovative engagement activities that foster community interaction and awareness. Her keen ability to evaluate the effectiveness of these initiatives allows her to refine strategies continually, ensuring that the NIH remains at the forefront of health promotion and public engagement.  
  
With a strong foundation in community outreach and health promotion, Anna is adept at utilizing tools like Photoshop and web design to create visually compelling content that captures attention and drives engagement. Her time management skills enable her to juggle multiple projects while maintaining a focus on quality and impact. About Shubham Housing Development Finance Company
-------------------------------------------------

With the opening up of the Indian economy, more and more people have shifted base to the cities in the hope of earning a few thousand more. 350 million people in India live in urban centers today and this figure is slated to double by 2030. This has led to a crisis-like situation in major urban centers, especially in the housing segment with almost 50% of the urban population living in low-quality houses  
  
As the urban cup fills up, real estate rates go up and affordability declines. Access to Credit is a key enabler towards increasing affordability. Therefore, in an honest effort to reach out to more people and provide them with facilities, we bring you Shubham Housing Development Finance Company. Our Vision is ‘To be the mortgage lender of choice for individuals with informal incomes’ - the intention being to ensure that irrespective of the source of income, we should be able to provide loans to individuals towards making a better home for themselves.  
  
As of 2022, the Company has a 100 branch network spread across 73 cities in 9 states across the Northern, Western and Central parts of India.

About Pacific Symphony
----------------------

Pacific Symphony, led by Music Director Carl St.Clair for the last 29 years, has been the resident orchestra of the Renée and Henry Segerstrom Concert Hall for over a decade. Currently in its 40th season, the Symphony is the largest orchestra formed in the U.S. in the last 50 years and is recognized as an outstanding ensemble making strides on both the national and international scene, as well as in its own community of Orange County.  
  
In April 2018, Pacific Symphony made its debut at Carnegie Hall as one of two orchestras invited to perform during a yearlong celebration of composer Philip Glass’ 80th birthday, and the following month the orchestra toured China. The orchestra made its national PBS debut in June 2018 on Great Performances with Peter Boyer’s “Ellis Island: The Dream of America,” conducted by St.Clair.  
  
Presenting more than 100 concerts and events a year and a rich array of education and community engagement programs, the Symphony reaches more than 300,000 residents—from school children to senior citizens.

About M1 Composites Technology Inc.
-----------------------------------

M1 is a TCCA (AMO23-12 and DAO 14-Q-01), with FAA, and EASA approved 145 repair station and design approval organization (DER Repairs) specializing in advanced composites and sheet metal structures. M1 finds solutions rapidly to ensure legacy and new weapon systems are mission ready. This is accomplished by providing specialty products and services to the commercial and defense aerospace sectors including new & reverse engineering, certification (STCs & PMA parts), manufacturing, repair, welding, and NDT/NDI. We are a leader in repair and overhaul of nacelles, flight control surfaces, radomes, LG doors, interiors, fairings, cargo nets, and much more. In addition, we are an Airbus and Boeing (Gold) approved supplier that is ISO9001/AS9100/AS9110 certified, military clearances.  
  
  
Technologie M1 Composites est une entreprise de calibre mondial, opérant dans des installations à la fine pointe de la technologie, situées stratégiquement dans la grappe aérospatiale de Montréal. M1 Composites est accrédité par le Programme de marchandises contrôlées (CCGP) canadien, approuvé comme organisme de maintenance agréé (AMO 23-12) par Transports Canada de même qu'organisme d'approbation de conception (DAO 14-Q-01), certifié ISO9001 & AS9100, spécialisé dans les structures et matériaux composites avancés. M1 Composites offre un éventail de services complets spécialisés pour l'industrie aérospatiale commerciale et militaire incluant: réparation de composants, ingénierie, fabrication, essai non destructif (NDT): Eddy Current, inspection thermographique, inspection Pulse thermographique, inspection de l’élasticité Laminate Checker (Elch), inspection ultrasonique, réparation de cargo nets et de parachutes. Notre succès découle de la confiance de nos clients, gagnée par le biais d’une qualité exceptionnelle, service et délai d'exécution rapide à prix compétitifs.

About Radio Television Brunei (RTB)
-----------------------------------

Radio Television Brunei (RTB) was born in 1957. Half a century later it has come a long way from those pioneering days. Of course, back then, RTB was only about Radio, but it was proud of its transmission of TV in full color being added to the organization’s repertoire in 1975. The arrival of television in 1975 not only provided a wide range of new opportunities for new services, but also related challenges in terms of developing or acquiring technical and production abilities using Information Technology capabilities. As a government owned broadcasting station, Radio Television Brunei is one of the key means of communication between His Majesty’s Government and the people of Brunei Darussalam. Therefore, this media communication is a prime mission of RTB.  
  
The impact of social media in the 21st century has arrived with a need to address the challenges of the globalisation, information and communication technology age. In the era of digitalisation, RTB felt the impact of digital technology in all walks of life. The trends of broadcasting and IT industry are changing very fast due to the development and convergence of digital technology. Consequently, RTB’s mission changed to: “To inform, to entertain, to educate, to inspire and to interact anytime, anywhere and in any way”.

About Clearwater Capital Partners
---------------------------------

Clearwater Capital Partners provides investors with access to a full spectrum of special-situation investments in public and private debt or equity of local, Asia-region issuers. In doing so, Clearwater also assists owners and management, particularly of the region's often capital-constrained small-to-medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), to create financial and operating restructurings that will allow their companies to succeed. In addition, by facilitating these successful restructurings, the firm has become a valuable and trusted resource to the region's banks, brokers and other business intermediaries.From its inception in 2001, Clearwater has expanded its activities to six global locations, including locally staffed offices in Hong Kong, New York, Singapore, Mumbai, Seoul and Beijing. The breadth of the targeted investment market and Clearwater's established and experienced "on-the-ground" presence makes it possible for the firm to source, develop and capture value in diverse opportunities across capital structures that include but are not limited to:investments in post-restructured or operationally sound public and private companies that are undervalued or poorly capitalized due to their inaccessibility to capital, financial restructurings,operational turnarounds and portfolios, pools and individual non-performing loans.

About City of Arvada
--------------------

Arvada, Colorado is a beautiful first-ring suburb of Denver, the Mile High City. Arvada retains a small-town feel even with its estimated population of 115,368. Established in 1870, Arvada enjoys a rich history, quiet tree-lined neighborhoods, and a robust mix of business. Our strong civic leadership balances quality of life with an understanding and support of business and economic development.  
  
Arvada's land encompasses nearly 23,000 acres. Three proximate interstate highways provide easy access to the larger metropolitan region and Denver International Airport. An extraordinary trail system links with Denver trails on the east and the foothills of the Rocky Mountains to the west, punctuated with thousands of acres of parks and open spaces.  
  
Residents and businesses have easy access to world-class research institutions including the University of Colorado and Colorado School of Mines; in addition, the Arvada campus of Red Rocks Community College provides training assistance to meet employer needs.  
  
Arvada offers unique amenities. The historic downtown, listed on the National Register of Historic Places, provides an eclectic shopping and dining experience, and in the near future will include one of three area transit stops as part of the metropolitan commuter rail system currently under development.  
  
Arvada's diverse economic base, highly educated workforce, low crime rate, and superb quality of life have helped shape our community into one of the most attractive and competitive cities in the Centennial State!
