About UFOP - Universidade Federal de Ouro Preto
-----------------------------------------------

Tradition, modernity and innovation are characteristics in the identity of the Federal University of Ouro Preto (Universidade Federal de Ouro Preto - UFOP). It was the innovative spirit, present since the creation of the School of Pharmacy, in 1839, and the School of Mines, in 1876, that became the basis from which would be born, in 1969, the Federal University of Ouro Preto. Ten years later it had already incorporated the Institute of Human and Social Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Humanas e Sociais - ICHS). Driven towards the strengthening of teaching, research and extension, other academic unities were created: the Institute of Philosophy, Arts and Culture (Instituto de Filosofia, Artes e Cultura - IFAC); the Institute of Exact and Biological Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Exatas e Biológicas - ICEB); The School of Nutrition (Escola de Nutrição - ENUT); the Center of Open and Distance Education (Centro de Educação Aberta e a Distância - CEAD); the Institute of Exact and Applied Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Exatas e Aplicadas - ICEA) and the Institute of Applied Social Sciences (Instituto de Ciências Sociais Aplicadas - ICSA). Today, UFOP is a reference in Brazil among the important Federal Institutions of Higher Education (Instituições Federais de Ensino Superior - IFES) of the country. This projection is due to its singularity on the historical dimensions of education, research, innovation and community involvement and especially to the appreciation given to its human patrimony: students, faculty and administrative-staff members. With campuses in three different cities, Ouro Preto, Mariana and João Monlevade, the university is located in the mesoregion of Belo Horizonte, expanding itself as far as João Monlevade, and in the microregion of Ouro Preto. Currently, the university occupies an area of approximately 151,000 m² (about 180,000 yd2), with over 150 classrooms and 140 teaching and research labs.

About Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
-------------------------------------

The Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum, located at 25 Evans Way in Boston, Massachusetts, is a cultural gem renowned for its extraordinary art collection and unique architectural design. Modeled after a Venetian palazzo, the museum offers visitors an immersive experience, combining the beauty of a flower-filled courtyard with meticulously curated galleries that house over 2,500 works of art. This includes European, Asian, and American masterpieces, as well as decorative arts and textiles, making it a significant player in the art and cultural heritage industry.  
  
The museum serves a diverse audience, including art enthusiasts, scholars, and families, providing educational programs, guided tours, and special exhibitions that foster a deeper appreciation for the arts. Its commitment to accessibility and community engagement is evident through various outreach initiatives and partnerships with local organizations. The Gardner Museum also embraces technology, utilizing digital platforms to enhance visitor experiences, such as virtual tours and interactive displays that bring the collection to life.  
  
In addition to its impressive art collection, the museum is dedicated to preserving the legacy of its founder, Isabella Stewart Gardner, whose vision was to create a space where art and community could thrive. The museum's unique ambiance, characterized by its stunning architecture and lush gardens, makes it a must-visit destination in Boston. Whether you are exploring the intricate details of a Vermeer painting or enjoying a moment of tranquility in the courtyard, the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum offers an unparalleled journey through art and history.

About ALABAMA STATE BOARD OF MEDICAL EXAMINERS
----------------------------------------------

The Alabama Board of Medical Examiners and Medical Licensure Commission of Alabama are charged with protecting the health and safety of Alabama patients.  
  
Some of the duties of the Board include:  
\- Certifying that initial applicants meet the statutory requirements for a license to practice medicine or osteopathy or as assistants to physicians in Alabama;  
\- Acting as a certifying board and issuing/renewing Alabama Controlled Substances Certificates;  
\- Enforcing the Alabama Controlled Substances Act;  
\- Approve applications for collaborative practice in Alabama in concert with the Alabama Board of Nursing;  
\- Investigating and prosecuting complaints against licensees for violations of Alabama's Medical Practice Act; and  
\- Establishing and reviewing compliance with continuing medical education requirements for physicians and assistants to physicians.

About DHL Global Forwarding Ireland
-----------------------------------

DHL – The logistics company for the world  
  
DHL is the global market leader in the logistics and transportation industry and “The logistics company for the world”. DHL commits its expertise in international express, national and international parcel delivery, air and ocean freight, road and rail transportation as well as contract and e-commerce related solutions along the entire supply chain. A global network composed of more than 220 countries and territories and around 315,000 employees worldwide offers customers superior service quality and local knowledge to satisfy their shipping and supply chain requirements.  
  
DHL is part of Deutsche Post DHL. The Group generates revenues of more than 55 billion per annum.  
  
DHL Global Forwarding in Ireland is the division of the organisation responsible for the efficient co-ordination and movement of cargo worldwide. Our size and experience allow us to tailor highly competitive global transport solutions for our B2B customer base, engaged in international trade.  
  
From small businesses looking to move less than an Ocean Freight container, to large multi-nationals serving global markets, DHL Global Forwarding develop customised solutions across all key industry sectors.

About Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC)
----------------------------------------------

Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC) is one of Australia's leading centres for live performance. Welcoming over 1.3 million visitors to more than 1,200 performances each year, we embrace the best in live performance – the world renowned alongside the emerging, local and new – and connect to the stories and ideas at the heart of each production. Through the warmth and expertise of our staff, we have become a trusted curator, presenter and host; a place to come together to relax, reflect, share stories and celebrate.  
  
QPAC is located in the vibrant cultural and educational precinct at South Bank that encompasses the Cultural Precinct (QPAC, Queensland Art Gallery | Gallery of Modern Art, Queensland Museum and State Library of Queensland) as well as Griffith University, Queensland University of Technology, Opera Queensland, Queensland Symphony Orchestra, Queensland Theatre, Merivale Street Studio, The Australian Broadcasting Corporation and Brisbane Convention and Exhibition Centre. This precinct is unique in Australia in size and character.  
  
At the heart of QPAC's activities is the aim to cultivate excellence in cultural thinking, planning and delivery and help build the success of art in Queensland. QPAC strives to be a place that is readily accessible, filled with people learning, exploring and having fun.

About FashionCapital / Fashion Enter
------------------------------------

Fashion-Enter Ltd (FEL) is an award-winning social enterprise which is a centre of ethical garment manufacturing with a leading status in the Fast Forward audit and is also SMETA audited. FEL has a minimum order quantity of 1 for their Fashion Studio service and currently produces up to 30,000 garments a week for speed of response fashion from their three units in Haringey, North London and Wales. Clients include ASOS, N Brown and Simply B, I Saw it First, Brora and brands such as Louisa Parris and Matthew Williamson.  
  
FEL's sister company FashionCapital.co.uk provides tailored business support, one to one mentoring and masterclasses for emerging designers and start-ups.  
  
FEL launched the UK's first SFA approved Fashion Technology Academy in 2015 operating alongside the Factory and includes a range of qualifications at Levels 1 to 5 covering the 'Garment life cycle' including Stitching, Production, Pattern Cutting and Tailoring. FEL is also the largest training providers of Apprenticeships at levels 3 and 4 within Apparel Manufacturing (fashion) working with employers such as ASOS.com, Marks & Spencer, River Island and Amazon.  
  
In November 2019 FEL launched the Tailoring Academy following funding from the Mayor of London's Good Growth Fund and Haringey Council. The Tailoring Academy is a state-of-the-art clothing manufacturing and training facility based which provides specialist skills, job training and apprenticeships for ready to wear and bespoke tailoring. Current clients include Gieves and Hawke, Harrods and Ralph and Russo.  
  
FEL works constantly with local authorities to create new training and job opportunities such as Leicester City Council and a new Fashion Technology Academy which is opening August 2021.  
  
FEL will open a new academy in Newtown, Wales in September 2021.

About OniBus
------------

Onibus is a service-based company (app and web-based platform) that provides a smarter way of communication between school and parents regarding all key activities of their students. Onibus is a platform that brings technology to schools and helps the parents to stay updated with their child’s curriculum. The key features of Onibus include online notice board for schools and parents, instant sharing of academic details of students, e-attendance with absent notifications, parent-teacher interaction through chat, school bus location, arrival notifications, etc. These features ensure serenity of minds and reduce the communication gap between parents and school.  
  
Onibus is a one-stop solution for all academic as well transport management problems. We incorporate technology to bring the serenity of minds to parents. Working parents, who are not able to take out time for their kid’s school curriculum, can regularly assess the day-to-day activities of their kids. The marks of different subjects and co-curriculum achievements can easily be accessed through the Onibus app. Parents can interact with the teacher as per their convenience. They can simply drop a message through ‘interaction’ the section on the app and the concerned teacher will reply to it.

To achieve our success as a global leader in wind technology, Goldwind companies employ a network of over 2,600 highly-skilled and savvy individuals worldwide. What services does Digital Mountain offer in the field of electronic discovery?

How does Digital Mountain ensure the security of sensitive data during the eDiscovery process?

At Digital Mountain, we prioritize cybersecurity and data protection. Our processes are built with robust security measures, including encryption, secure data transfer protocols, and strict access controls. We adhere to industry standards and compliance regulations to safeguard sensitive information throughout the eDiscovery lifecycle, ensuring that our clients' data remains confidential and secure.

What services does Metro Trains Melbourne provide?

Metro Trains Melbourne operates the suburban railway network in Melbourne, providing over 15,000 train services each week across 16 lines. The services include regular passenger trains, special event services, and accessibility options for individuals with disabilities. Additionally, Metro is involved in infrastructure projects and engineering solutions to enhance the efficiency and safety of the rail network.

How can I find train schedules and service updates?

Train schedules and service updates can be accessed through the Metro Trains Melbourne website or the official Metro app. The website provides real-time information on train departures, service disruptions, and planned maintenance. Users can also subscribe to service alerts via email or SMS to stay informed about any changes to their usual travel plans.

What measures does Metro Trains Melbourne take to ensure passenger safety?

Metro Trains Melbourne prioritizes passenger safety through various measures, including regular maintenance of trains and infrastructure, staff training, and the implementation of safety protocols. The network is equipped with CCTV surveillance, emergency communication systems, and safety personnel on trains and at stations. Additionally, Metro runs awareness campaigns to educate passengers about safe travel practices.

Are there any training programs offered by Metro Trains Melbourne?

Yes, Metro Trains Melbourne offers a range of training programs aimed at developing skills in various areas related to public transport and rail operations. This includes training for operational staff, engineering courses, and safety training for employees. The company is committed to fostering a skilled workforce to support its infrastructure and service delivery.

What initiatives does Metro Trains Melbourne have for sustainability?

Metro Trains Melbourne is committed to sustainability and reducing its environmental impact. Initiatives include the use of energy-efficient trains, waste reduction programs, and partnerships with local communities to promote public transport usage. The company is also investing in renewable energy sources and exploring innovative technologies to further enhance sustainability in its operations.

How does Metro Trains Melbourne support accessibility for passengers with disabilities?

Metro Trains Melbourne is dedicated to making its services accessible to all passengers, including those with disabilities. This includes features such as step-free access at many stations, designated seating on trains, and assistance from staff when needed. The company also provides information on accessible services through its website and customer service channels to ensure that all passengers can travel safely and comfortably.

What types of industries does Graphel Carbon Products serve?

Graphel Carbon Products serves a variety of industries that require high-performance graphite machining solutions. Key sectors include aerospace, automotive, semiconductor manufacturing, and energy. These industries often face high costs of failure, making Graphel's innovative graphite solutions essential for maintaining operational efficiency and reliability.

What is the significance of graphite machining in manufacturing?

Graphite machining is crucial in manufacturing because it offers superior thermal and electrical conductivity, lightweight properties, and excellent wear resistance. These characteristics make graphite an ideal material for tooling, fixtures, and components used in processes like Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) and furnace applications. Graphel Carbon Products specializes in providing precision graphite components that enhance manufacturing performance and reduce the risk of failure.

Can Graphel Carbon Products assist with custom tooling engineering?

Yes, Graphel Carbon Products offers custom tooling engineering services tailored to meet specific client needs. Their experienced engineering team collaborates with clients to design and manufacture bespoke tooling solutions that optimize production processes and improve overall efficiency. This customization ensures that clients receive tools that are perfectly suited to their unique applications.

What are the benefits of using Graphel's EDM machining services?

Graphel's EDM machining services provide numerous benefits, including high precision, the ability to machine complex geometries, and minimal material waste. Their advanced EDM technology allows for the creation of intricate shapes and fine details in graphite components, which are essential for high-performance applications. Additionally, Graphel's expertise in graphite ensures that the final products meet stringent quality standards, reducing the likelihood of failure in critical processes.

How does Graphel ensure the quality of its graphite products?

Graphel Carbon Products employs rigorous quality control measures throughout the manufacturing process. This includes sourcing high-grade graphite materials, utilizing advanced machining technologies, and conducting thorough inspections at various stages of production. Their commitment to quality ensures that every product meets or exceeds industry standards, providing clients with reliable and durable solutions for their manufacturing needs.

What types of furnace applications can Graphel support?

Graphel Carbon Products supports a wide range of furnace applications, including those used in metal processing, heat treatment, and sintering. Their graphite components are designed to withstand high temperatures and harsh environments, making them ideal for use in various furnace systems. By providing reliable fixtures and components, Graphel helps clients improve efficiency and reduce downtime in their furnace operations.

About Chinese American International School
-------------------------------------------

The Chinese American International School (CAIS), located at 150 Oak Street in San Francisco, is a pioneering educational institution that has been shaping the future of bilingual education since its inception in 1981. Founded by a diverse group of parents, educators, and civic leaders, CAIS offers a unique bilingual and multicultural curriculum in English and Chinese, designed to prepare students for an increasingly interconnected world. Under the visionary leadership of Shirley Lee, the school began with just four students in two modest classrooms, establishing itself as the first of its kind in the nation. Today, CAIS serves 556 students from Preschool through eighth grade, continuing to thrive as one of the few independent dual language immersion programs in the United States.  
  
With a commitment to fostering bicultural education, CAIS graduates are well-equipped to excel in leading high schools and universities, with many alumni pursuing careers in both China and the U.S. The school’s state-of-the-art 5.4-acre campus features exceptional facilities for athletics, arts, and teaching, complemented by ample outdoor space. Under the current leadership of Head of School Jeff Bissell, CAIS remains dedicated to its mission of empowering students to embrace their Chinese heritage, become their best selves, and carve out their unique places in the world. For those interested in the faculty, the Chinese American International School teachers list showcases a diverse and talented group committed to providing an enriching educational experience that celebrates cultural diversity and academic excellence.

About Euro Jet Intercontinental Ltd
-----------------------------------

Euro Jet is the leading provider of flight support services in Europe and Central Asia. We are the only company of its kind to have a network of our own agents spanning this region of the world. We provide ground handling support, permits, jet fuel, flight planning, hotel arrangements, crew transportation, catering, and credit facilities. Euro Jet supports over 10 000 flights a year for Executive Jets, Commercial, Cargo, and Military aircraft. Our 24/7 Operations Control Center and over 200 staff are ready to assist anytime. Over the past decade, Euro Jet has gone through a period of significant growth. As the company has expanded and we have grown our staff and increased our number of locations, we have not forgotten our ultimate goal of ensuring that every customer ends up being a long-term partner.  
  
We are very proud to be a one-of-a-kind ground support network and while we have our staff located all over the world and working in very difficult places, our aim is to provide each customer with a one-stop-shop allowing for an easy and worry-free experience.  
  
Though we do have our hangar in Prague and lounges located throughout our core region, we are a company of people. We have a highly experienced team of fluent English-speaking aviation professionals whose knowledge of both the airport and their respective city is the best out there.  
  
Our team carefully tracks your flights by utilizing Euro Jet’s unique smart phone application, keeping every customer informed in real time of all details from start to finish. In addition to all this, they have received NATA Safety 1st Training, which we feel is essential for anyone involved in ground operations.

About Italiana Assicurazioni
----------------------------

La nostra storia inizia nel 1889, quando nasce a Milano, per iniziativa di un gruppo di industriali tessili, la "Cooperativa Italiana Incendio". In oltre un secolo siamo diventati più grandi, più forti, più importanti, e dal 1966 facciamo parte del Gruppo Reale Mutua.  
  
La condivisione degli obiettivi e le sinergie con il Gruppo ci hanno permesso di essere particolarmente attivi e propositivi sul piano della consulenza finalizzata alla soddisfazione dei bisogni assicurativi.  
  
La qualità dei nostri prodotti e dei nostri servizi, la capacità consulenziale dei nostri Agenti e dei loro team di collaboratori ci hanno portato ad essere un vero e proprio partner assicurativo per oltre 800.000 clienti.  
Siamo presenti in tutta Italia con circa 358 Agenzie.  
  
L’Agenzia internazionale Fitch Rating di Londra ci ha assegnato il livello "Aq" del rating Q-IFS (Quantitative Insurer Financial Strenght) sulla base dei risultati al 31 dicembre 2006, indicatore di elevata capacità di adempiere agli obblighi contrattuali e a quelli verso i detentori di polizze: un'importante testimonianza della qualità del lavoro svolto.

This integration helps maintain high-quality standards while enabling rapid software delivery.

What are the benefits of using low-code test automation with mabl?

Low-code test automation with mabl significantly reduces the complexity and time required to create and maintain tests. Additionally, the intuitive interface allows for faster onboarding of new team members and quicker adaptation to changes in the application under test.

About Alpiq InTec Gruppo
------------------------

Alpiq InTec, un’affiliata di Alpiq Holding SA, è un’azienda svizzera con più di 90 sedi in tutte le regioni della Svizzera. Il gruppo aziendale è costituito da più società affiliate che si completano dal punto di vista geografico e tematico. Il gruppo Alpiq InTec (ex Atel Installationstechnik SA) con sede a Zurigo è un’azienda svizzera che opera nei settori impiantistica per edifici, gestione degli edifici, tecnica del traffico, tecnica dell’approvvigionamento energetico, automazione dei processi, consulenza in efficienza energetica ed e-mobility. Esso concentra le proprie attività in Svizzera e nell’Italia settentrionale e, per il settore tecnica del traffico, in tutta l’Europa. In Svizzera il gruppo Alpiq InTec dispone di più di 90 filiali in tutte le regioni. Composto da numerose società affiliate, occupa circa 4900 collaboratori, di cui circa 484 apprendisti, e nel 2016 ha realizzato un fatturato di CHF 204 milioni. Il gruppo Alpiq InTec è una società affiliata al cento per cento di Alpiq Holding SA ed è nato, all’inizio del 1999, dall’accorpamento delle imprese del gruppo Atel, attive nel settore della tecnica d’installazione, fino ad allora separate. Dopo la fusione di Atel ed EOS in un’unica azienda, Alpiq, nel 2009 il gruppo ha cambiato la sua denominazione in Alpiq InTec.

What does it take for a family-run company to become a world market leader in the premium domestic appliance and commercial machine segment?

And is the reason that our founders' guiding principle, “Immer Besser” – which translates as “Forever Better”, still shapes the company today. This stance accounts for a good working environment at Miele and the success of our products.  
  
Our colleagues can rest assured that those who live up to our standards of quality and professionalism grow personally and professionally. No matter if they are at entry levels or managers.  
  
Miele asks a lot of its employees. They are expected to develop and manufacture worldwide market premium products that are "Immer Besser". In return, they receive the most valuable thing Miele can give them: that they themselves become "Immer Besser" - in all of their professional and personal abilities.  
  
"Immer Besser" is, therefore, an entrepreneurial success principle from which customers and employees benefit in equal measure. We call this principle "MAKE IT BETTER. BE BETTER".

Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center, located in Baltimore, Maryland, is a full-service, Joint Commission-accredited academic medical center. Our key objective is to deliver our customers value with their service requirements, by providing innovative service solutions, whether its, material handling, logistics, earthworks, equipment solutions, our vast experience combined with operating to the highest standards of Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental compliance within the industry brings real benefits to any project.

The majority of our equipment is custom-built and uniquely designed to provide maximum value to the customer in efficiency whilst ensuring the highest levels of safety and environmental compliance whilst in operation.  
  
We utilise the rail and marine network to offer a seamless, sustainable and fully integrated transportation and logistics service, from source to delivery point, handling all types of bulk or containerised materials.  
  
RFS Limited has many years of experience that has given us an unrivaled wealth of knowledge of the services we provide which enables us to think beyond standard industry practice and strive to provide innovation in everything we do. We share this expertise with customers, consultants, quarry and freight operators alike to provide safe cost effective sustainable solutions.

About UCL Multimedia Anthropology Laboratory
--------------------------------------------

The UCL Multimedia Anthropology Lab (UCL MAL) is a research network aimed at developing innovative methods for anthropological practice. In a digital world where new technologies offer new ways to gather data and present research, UCL MAL experiments with media such as sound, film, VR/360 video, graphic novels, drawing, sculpture, and installations to theorise how they can contribute towards alternative forms of anthropological thinking. If anthropology is to remain relevant today we must develop new forms of practice which can dialogue with more diverse audiences, collaborate with colleagues across disciplines, and disrupt outdated models of thought.

About Henry Vilas Zoo
---------------------

Henry Vilas Zoo, located in Madison, Wisconsin, stands out as one of the last remaining free zoos in North America, offering an enriching experience for visitors of all ages. As an accredited member of the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA), the zoo is dedicated to the conservation and protection of wildlife and their habitats. With a mission centered around education, research, and community engagement, Henry Vilas Zoo serves as a vital resource for environmental awareness and animal welfare.  
  
The zoo showcases a diverse array of animal species, including mammals, birds, reptiles, and amphibians, providing guests with the opportunity to learn about the wonders of the natural world. Through immersive exhibits and engaging educational programs, Henry Vilas Zoo fosters a deeper understanding of biodiversity and the importance of conservation efforts. The zoo also participates in various breeding programs aimed at preserving endangered species, making it a key player in global wildlife conservation initiatives.  
  
In addition to its animal exhibits, Henry Vilas Zoo offers a range of services and amenities, including guided tours, interactive experiences, and seasonal events that enhance visitor engagement. The zoo employs modern technologies to improve animal care and habitat management, ensuring a safe and enriching environment for its residents. With its commitment to free access, Henry Vilas Zoo is not only a beloved local attraction but also a leader in the zoo industry, promoting conservation and education in a welcoming and inclusive setting.

What types of travel services does Select Italy offer?

Select Italy specializes in a wide range of travel services tailored to Italy, including personalized travel planning, guided tours, hotel bookings, transportation arrangements, and culinary experiences. Can Select Italy help with group travel arrangements?

Yes, Select Italy has extensive experience in organizing group travel. They can assist with everything from transportation and accommodations to guided tours and dining reservations. Whether you're planning a corporate retreat, a wedding party, or a family reunion, Select Italy can provide tailored solutions to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience for all participants.

What industries does Select Italy cater to?

Select Italy primarily serves the travel and tourism industry, but their services extend to various sectors including corporate travel, educational tours, and culinary tourism. Are there any special experiences or tours that Select Italy offers?

Absolutely! Select Italy offers a variety of unique experiences and tours, including private guided tours of historical landmarks, cooking classes with local chefs, wine tasting tours in renowned vineyards, and art and architecture tours in cities like Florence and Venice. These experiences are designed to provide travelers with an authentic and immersive understanding of Italian culture.

How does Select Italy ensure the quality of its services?

Select Italy is committed to providing high-quality services by partnering with reputable local suppliers and experts in the field. They conduct regular evaluations and feedback sessions to ensure that all aspects of their offerings meet the highest standards. Additionally, their team of experienced travel consultants is dedicated to understanding client needs and delivering exceptional service.

What is the process for booking a trip with Select Italy?

Booking a trip with Select Italy is a straightforward process. Interested travelers can start by filling out a request form on their website or contacting their travel consultants directly. Once the itinerary is approved, clients can finalize their bookings, and Select Italy will take care of all arrangements, ensuring a hassle-free travel experience.

About 浙江越秀外国语学院
---------------

浙江越秀外国语学院是一所经国家教育部批准设立的全日制普通本科高校。学校位于中国首批历史文化名城、著名的江南水乡、鲁迅的故乡——浙江绍兴。学校始创于1981年，2008年经国家教育部批准升格为本科高校。  
  
学校现有稽山、镜湖两个校区，占地面积1000余亩，校园建筑面积40余万平方米；现有全日制在校生16000余名，教师800余名，副高以上职称教师占专任教师30.71%，硕博学历学位教师占76.13%，博士学位教师占12.54%。学校长年聘请外籍教师近百名，2014年聘有涵盖开设九个语种的，来自美国、英国、加拿大等二十余个国家，外籍教师117人次。  
  
学校设有英语学院、东方语言学院、西方语言学院、国际商学院、网络传播、中国语言文化（国际教育）学院、酒店管理学院、美国印第安纳波利斯大学国际学院等10个二级学院。现开设40个本专科专业，含英语、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语、法语、德语、俄语、西班牙语、意大利语等9个外语语种，是浙江省开设外语语种众多，外语人才培养特色鲜明的本科外国语高校。  
  
学校拥有外国语言文学等省级重点学科外国语言学及应用语言学和法语语言文学等市级重点学科；朝鲜语专业为浙江省优势专业建设项目，英语专业为绍兴市特色专业建设项目，日语专业为绍兴市重点建设专业。

About Putera Sampoerna Foundation
---------------------------------

The Putera Sampoerna Foundation (PSF) is the first Social Business Institution in Indonesia with the vision to create eminent and responsible future leaders and entrepreneurs for Indonesia to face the challenges of global participation.  
  
The four main pillars of the Putera Sampoerna Foundation are the provision of quality education to Indonesia’s economically underprivileged; building Entrepreneurship skills and eco-systems for economic development; empowerment of women and support of Compassionate Relief programs.  
Since its inception in 2001, the Putera Sampoerna Foundation has distributed more than 34,000 scholarships, provided training for more than 14,000 teachers and principals, and adopted 17 public schools and 5 Islamic schools.  
  
The Putera Sampoerna Foundation is the first non-profit organization to receive the ISO 9001:2008 certificate of quality management systems which are of international standard. Applying the principles of transparency and accountability in all its activities, the Putera Sampoerna Foundation has been trusted by more than 250 corporations, organizations and associations as a provider for Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs. The Putera Sampoerna Foundation is periodically audited by a third-party international auditor and its report is published in the Putera Sampoerna Foundation's annual report.

About Neurogene Inc.
--------------------

Neurogene is accelerating development of new genetic medicines to people with devastating neurological diseases and their families. To do this, we are working with experts across the globe to advance a broad pipeline of programs to treat the underlying cause of serious neurological disorders and thereby address the overwhelming need for new therapies.  
  
Although the human genome was sequenced for the first time nearly 20 years ago, the true genomics revolution is taking place now, providing us with the ability to radically alter rare, genetic disorders. At Neurogene, we are working to provide medicines to improve the lives of neurologically-impaired and developmentally-delayed children and their families.  
  
We are building a team of passionate, driven individuals who envision a world in which all families have access to genetic medicines, even if the disorder is exceedingly rare.  
  
To learn more, please visit http://www.neurogene.com/careers/.

About World Food Programme
--------------------------

The World Food Programme is a leader in the global movement to achieve Zero Hunger. In 80 countries, our innovative hunger solutions are benefiting some 80 million people.  
  
In emergencies, we get food to where it is needed, saving the lives of victims of war, civil conflict and natural disasters. After the cause of an emergency has passed, we use food to help communities rebuild their shattered lives.  
  
WFP is part of the United Nations system and is voluntarily funded.  
  
Born in 1961, WFP pursues a vision of the world in which every man, woman and child has access at all times to the food needed for an active and healthy life. We work towards that vision with our sister UN agencies in Rome -- the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) -- as well as other government, UN and NGO partners.

---------------------------------------

With our 24/7/365 contact center and alarm monitoring central station, CRC has merged the benefits of personalized service with the efficiencies provided by technologically advanced computer and telephony systems. At CRC, we pride ourselves on Focusing on the Human Side of Technology®.Focusing on the Human Side of Technology means more than having live agents answer the phone. At CRC, it’s about finding ways to share our 24/7 call and alarm handling as well as dispatch technologies with those who need it most. For over 25 years, utilities have turned to CRC to help them turn staffing challenges into seamless solutions. What’s more, if something unexpected happens, CRC can help with just a flip of a switch. A major outage event, equipment failure, a tornado; these are just a few of the times when our customers have needed us most. That’s the service you can count on with CRC.Founded in 1992, CRC’s Central Station is a CSAA Five-Diamond certified, UL-listed full service central station providing security, environmental, and medical alarm monitoring, as well as video verified asset monitoring services. About Gary Housing Authority
----------------------------

Since 1938, The Gary Housing Authority has been providing rental for low and moderate income households in the City of Gary Indiana. The agency owns and operates 1,919 public housing units, administers an ongoing public housing rehabilitation program averaging $3.66 million annually, and administers a Section 8 program that provides assistance on behalf of over 2,000 households in the City of Gary. GHA is a partner in two HOPE VI programs, Horace Mann and Duneland through the federal HOPE VI Program.  
  
  
GHA Mission Statement:  
The Gary Housing Authority shall at all times develop and operate each public housing development solely for the purpose of providing decent safe and sanitary housing for eligible families in a manner that promotes serviceability, economy, efficiency, and stability of the housing developments and the economic and social well-being of the residents.

About Transportation Research Board
-----------------------------------

The Transportation Research Board (TRB), part of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine, promotes innovation and progress in transportation through research. In an objective and interdisciplinary setting, TRB facilitates the sharing of information on transportation practice and policy by researchers and practitioners; stimulates research and offers research management services that promote technical excellence; provide expert advice on transportation policy and programs; and disseminates research results broadly and encouraged their implementation.  
  
The National Academies are private, nonprofit institutions that provide expert advice on some of the most pressing challenges facing the nation and the world. TRB is supported by state transportation departments, federal agencies including the component administrations of the U.S. Department of Transportation, and other organizations and individuals interested in the development of transportation.  
  
TRB was established in 1920 as the National Advisory Board on Highway Research to provide a mechanism for the exchange of information and research results about highway technology.

About 3D Instruments, LP
------------------------

3D Instruments designs and manufactures custom direct drive gauges that deliver unmatched durability, ease of use, performance and precision for mission-critical applications. With U.S.- based manufacturing, sales, customer service, technical support and a coast-to-coast distribution network, 3D Instruments can help you build world-class products and operations. 3D Instruments is part of the Global WIKA Group, world wide market leader in Pressure, Temperature, Flow and Level Measurement technology.  
  
If you have to develop SCBA equipment that will allow a firefighter to take a breath in a raging inferno... or craft a landing gear system on a jet…or maintain a pump with severe vibration... then you know what it’s like to develop equipment for the most dangerous scenarios.  
  
As your users do their jobs, they put their lives in your hands. In the case of breathing equipment or aerospace engineering, it’s actually a human life. In industrial plants, it could be a human life, but more frequently it’s the life of important machinery and if it goes down then the plant shuts down.  
  
Our direct drive pressure gauge has only one working part—a helically-wound Bourdon tube made either of Copper Beryllium or Inconel® X-750, a flexible material that prevents the coil from losing its shape and thus ensuring accuracy. With no additional mechanical components vulnerable to wear, a direct drive gauge lasts longer than C-shape Bourdon tube gauges, thus reducing down time and total cost of ownership.

About Connect India E-Commerce Services Private Limited
-------------------------------------------------------

Connect India is a movement born on account of the necessity for providing a level playing field in logistics by reaching the unreached. Connect India’s vision is to create a pan India last mile delivery network covering 25000 pin codes by leveraging the existing economic assets such as the brick and mortar retailer and the digital India platform by engaging in a robust mobile-first technology. Connect India targets to appoint 50,000 last-mile delivery entrepreneurs as Connect India Centers (CICs), who in turn will provide employment to 200,000 plus delivery associates from their local communities in the next 3 years.  
  
Our pan India outreach is designed to provide logistics access to one and all from e –commerce companies to a small household enterprise. The idea is to develop a neighborhood convenience model of 1 sq. km delivery areas for urban markets and last mile access for rural markets. The last mile delivery will be affected through walk or cycle, which will not only reduce cost of delivery but also be environmentally positive. At Connect India, we believe, that a reliable and robust micro-logistic pipeline with dedicated vans on pre-determined routes in a time definite manner can encourage small brown box commerce, wherein, households, and small and medium enterprises can fuel their growth through the digital market place. The objective of Connect India is to create a better opportunity for these businesses and encourage them to bring best in design and packaging solutions.  
  
Connect India plans to collaborate with different like-minded agencies and brands to build a truly inclusive India by promoting brown box commerce with a 360 degree approach which is only complete by enabling cash management for the business on a same day basis. We will encourage Rural Enterprise (Re) Commerce disrupting the logistics market by aggregating logistics and promoting more logistic capacities in rural and urban India in an integrated manner.

About Sarasota Family YMCA
--------------------------

The Sarasota Family YMCA has been at the heart of Sarasota since 1945. Today, we touch over 70,000 lives through our four fitness branches and offer more than 50 youth and family development programs within four counties in Southwest Florida. We live our not-for-profit mission by providing life changing experiences and assistance to everyone of all ages, background, ability, race or religion.  
  
Our Philosophy  
  
As a charitable association of all ages, ethnic groups and religious affiliations, we are united in putting Judeo-Christian principals into practice through programs that enrich the quality of spiritual, mental, physical and social life for children, families and our community. The YMCA challenges people to live by the values of caring, honesty, respect and responsibility. We're for: Youth Development, Healthy Living and Social Responsibility.

At Forth Ports we do much more than simply manage cargo passing through our eight ports across the UK. We are intrinsically connected to the success of the local and national economies in which we operate. The commodities which we handle allow our economy to thrive and trade, enhancing the quality of life of many people in the UK and countries around the world.  
  
As the 3rd largest UK port group, handling in the range of 41 million tonnes of cargo a year we play a pinnacle role in supporting a diverse range of customers and sectors.  
  
From our strategically located ports we provide a range of safe, reliable & efficient supply chain services to help customer to simplify their supply chains, reduce cost but ensure consistency, transparency and a high quality of service.  
  
Working to understand our customers and their supply chains is what we do to help develop customer lead bespoke solutions through our diverse knowledge and expertise.  
  
Our continuous commitment to investing for the future has positioned Forth Ports as a market leader in supporting major and specialist projects for customers across a vast array of industries, adding real value in the process.  
  
With over 1,100 employees, Forth Ports has grown to be a major UK employer, key contributor to the national economy, and trusted partner to an ever-increasing number of industry leading customers. Our ports assist in developing logistics flows across the UK and support many key industries.  
  
This is an exciting time for the business building a new port for London. Tilbury2 will be a major infrastructure project for the UK at a time when the country needs its ports more than ever.  
  
In Scotland, we are developing a range of services and facilities to meet the current and future demands of key industry sectors including agriculture, north sea oil & gas and renewables.  
  
We are not standing still, we are investing and adapting to support our futures change.

About Ambit Biosciences
-----------------------

Ambit Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of drugs to treat unmet medical needs in oncology, autoimmune and inflammatory diseases by inhibiting kinases that are important drivers for those diseases. Our pipeline currently includes three programs, each aimed at the inhibition of validated kinase targets.  
  
Our lead drug candidate, quizartinib, is a once-daily, orally-administered, potent and selective inhibitor of FMS-like tyrosine kinase 3 (FLT3), a validated target in the treatment of AML, and is currently in Phase 2b clinical development in relapsed/refractory AML patients who express the FLT3-ITD mutation (FLT3-ITD positive patients). The FLT3-ITD mutation acts like a “power switch” that causes leukemic cells, or blasts, to spread more aggressively and grow back more rapidly following chemotherapy, conferring an especially poor survival outcome. Quizartinib is designed to turn off this switch.  
  
Our second drug candidate in clinical development, AC410, is a potent, selective, orally-administered, small molecule inhibitor of Janus kinase 2 (JAK2) that has potential utility for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.  
  
Our third program consists of a potent and exquisitely selective small molecule compound, AC708, which inhibits the colony-stimulating factor-1 receptor (CSF1R), a receptor tyrosine kinase. This compound is in preclinical studies and has potential utility in oncology, autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. All of our drug candidates and clinical candidates have been internally discovered by us.

Alice Faye's legacy as an American actress and singer is one of unparalleled talent, grace, and artistry. About Regional State Administrative Agency

Aluehallintovirasto (avi) hoitaa Suomen lainsäädännön toimeenpano-, ohjaus- ja valvontatehtäviä eri alueilla. Avi edistää perusoikeuksien ja oikeusturvan toteutumista, peruspalvelujen saatavuutta, ympäristönsuojelua, ympäristön kestävää käyttöä, sisäistä turvallisuutta, opetus- ja kulttuuritoimen palveluja sekä terveellistä ja turvallista elin- ja työympäristöä.Avi hyödyntää toiminnassaan viraston monipuolista asiantuntijuutta. Virasto hoitaa kahdeksan eri ministeriön alaisuuteen kuuluvia tehtäviä. Suomessa on kuusi aluehallintovirastoa, joilla on yhteensä 13 toimipistettä. Palveluksessamme on yhteensä noin 1300 henkilöä. Päätoimipaikkojen (Hämeenlinna, Turku, Vaasa, Mikkeli, Oulu ja Rovaniemi) lisäksi aluehallintovirastojen henkilöstöä työskentelee Kouvolassa, Helsingissä, Kuopiossa, Joensuussa, Jyväskylässä, Tampereella ja Porissa. Lisäksi henkilöstöä työskentelee myös muilla paikkakunnilla. Tarkemmat tiedot virastoista ja niiden tehtävistä osoitteessa www.avi.fi.The Regional State Administrative Agency carries out executive, steering and supervisory tasks of the Finnish legislation in the regions. The Agency promotes the implementation of basic rights and legal protection, access to basic public services, environmental protection, environmental sustainability, internal security, education and cultural services and a safe and healthy living and working environment. There are six Regional State Administrative Agencies in Finland, operating in a total of 13 locations.In their operations, the Agencies utilise their versatile expertise. They carry out tasks under eight different ministries. The Agency’s tasks are mainly carried out regionally, with each Agency taking care of them for its operating region. However, there are also tasks that are carried out in a centralised manner by certain Agency or Agencies. Further information about the tasks and responsibilities at the Agency’s website (www.avi.fi).

About Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG
------------------------------------

Heidelberger Druckmaschinen Aktiengesellschaft is a reliable and highly innovative partner to the global printing industry.  
  
For more than 170 years we have stood for quality and future viability. This means that we are a company with a long tradition, but at the same time we help define the future trends in our industry thanks to state-of-the-art technologies and innovative business ideas. Our mission is to shape the digital future of our industry.  
  
We play a leading technological role with our integrated range of solutions and new digital business models. In doing so, we focus on the systematic end-to-end digitization of customer value creation, with a particular view to integrated system solutions for machines, software, consumer goods and performance services.  
  
With our technology leadership in our core business and a focus on digitization, we are addressing a global market in which experts expect to see moderate growth in the coming years, with strong foundations for our products and services thanks to an annual print production volume of over € 400 billion in packaging, advertising and label printing.  
We are also addressing new markets beyond the printing industry. For example, we have successfully established ourselves in the e-mobility market with our expertise in power electronics. Our printing technology also gives us access to the production of printed organic electronics, a future market with great potential.

Signature Boston is the name for Boston’s convention and meetings experience, and includes the Massachusetts Convention Center Authority (MCCA), Boston Convention Marketing Center (BCMC), and our partners in Boston’s hospitality community.  
  
Signature Boston represents all of the unique benefits and advantages of bringing your event to Boston. About Tippet Richardson

As a leading relocation service institution in Canada, Tippet Richardson continues to evolve towards the goal of being the world’s most trusted moving company. Founded in 1927, Tippets offers renowned expertise in all areas of your business or personal relocation expectations whether it is locally, across Canada, cross-border to U.S.A., or internationally.  
  
With a network of 4 offices in Canada (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto & Ottawa) as well as its extensively experienced affiliates across North America and worldwide, Tippet Richardson strives to exceed our customers’ expectations and maintain their loyalty for a lifetime.  
  
By fostering a highly professional, supportive working environment that encourages employee excellence, integrity, and teamwork, our consultants constantly endeavor to coordinate the timing of the packing, shipping and delivery of all your furnishings to the highest of international standards using a full range of cartons and special materials. We are proud to provide excellent and efficient moving services in order to make your move straightforward and stress free by providing all pertinent answers to questions regarding documentation, insurance, customs clearance and the arrival of your personal effects.  
  
All Tippet Richardson storage facilities are monitored 24-hours a day by electronic security systems. Buildings are equipped with high-tech sprinklers and are climate controlled. Our warehouses are bonded and operated by trained staff to provide you with the highest level of professional and courteous service.  
  
As members of the most recognized associations for quality in the moving business Industry - LACMA, BAR, IAM, PAIMA, EUROVAN, AMSA and CAM, we believe our services are of the highest standards, ensuring your items are safely and securely delivered to their destination.

The Michigan Science Center (MiSci) is a Smithsonian affiliate that inspires nearly 250,000 curious minds of all ages every year through STEM (science, technology, engineering, and math) discovery, innovation and interactive education in Detroit and across Michigan. As a STEM hub, MiSci focuses on developing and introducing expanded education programs, exhibits and initiatives to empower and enrich our children and community.  
  
Through our Traveling Science Program and distance learning initiative, ECHO, we are expanding beyond our Detroit-based facility, with a goal of reaching all 83 counties of Michigan. With the Toyota Engineering 4D Theater, live science demonstrations, lab activities and 220+ interactive exhibits, there are dozens of ways to customize your MiSci visit. The Michigan Science Center is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization and does not receive funding from Detroit or the state of Michigan. LaFrance Corp supports branding through the creation of customized branding elements such as metal logos, decorative trim, and functional components. Equation has worked since 1989 across Nottinghamshire to reduce and prevent domestic abuse. Equation prevents and responds to abuse through: -Prevention programmes with children and young people, delivering healthy relationships projects in schools -Campaigns to change damaging attitudes about gender and relationships -Training community professionals such as police officers, social workers and medical staff to offer fast and effective responses to domestic abuse -Information for survivors of domestic violence about where to go for help -Direct practical and emotional support to men experiencing domestic abuse. Through this we are: EQUIPPING communities with the knowledge and information that allows everyone to make positive relationship choices, recognise abuse and challenge domestic violence ENABLING survivors of domestic abuse to access help through guidance and support EMPOWERING individuals with the confidence to speak out against domestic violence and gender inequality, and the self-esteem to recognise their rights to a healthy relationship

About Xenon Pharmaceuticals
---------------------------

XENON® is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel medicines through the application of our proprietary discovery platform, which we refer to as Extreme Genetics. Our product candidates are based on genetic insights derived from our research of families where individuals exhibit severe traits, or phenotypes. We apply our expertise to predict which phenotypes are caused by single-gene defects. By identifying and characterizing the single-gene defects responsible for such severe phenotypes, we gain valuable insights into their function in human biology and their potential as drug targets. Given that these targets are often involved in diseases beyond the rare genetic disorders in which they are first identified, we are developing proprietary product candidates to treat both orphan as well as more prevalent diseases

What types of shipping services does ShipLilly offer?

ShipLilly provides a comprehensive range of shipping services, including ocean shipping, freight forwarding, and domestic trucking. Our services are designed to cater to both import and export needs, ensuring that your goods are transported efficiently and safely across borders. We also offer specialized solutions such as customs house brokerage and trade financing to facilitate seamless international trade.

How does ShipLilly handle inventory management?

At ShipLilly, we offer robust inventory management solutions that help businesses keep track of their stock levels, manage order fulfillment, and optimize warehouse space. Our advanced inventory management system integrates with various platforms to provide real-time visibility into your inventory, allowing you to make informed decisions and reduce costs associated with excess stock or stockouts.

What industries does ShipLilly support?

ShipLilly serves a diverse range of industries, including retail, manufacturing, e-commerce, and pharmaceuticals. Our expertise in logistics allows us to tailor our services to meet the unique needs of each industry, ensuring that we provide effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency and reduce operational costs.

Can ShipLilly assist with customs clearance?

Yes, ShipLilly offers customs house brokerage services to help you navigate the complexities of customs clearance. Our experienced team is well-versed in international trade regulations and can assist with documentation, tariff classification, and compliance to ensure that your shipments clear customs smoothly and without delays.

What is a Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) and how can ShipLilly help?

A Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) is a designated area where goods can be imported, stored, and manipulated without being subject to customs duties until they leave the zone. ShipLilly can assist businesses in utilizing FTZs to optimize their supply chain, reduce costs, and improve cash flow. Our team can guide you through the process of establishing and managing your operations within an FTZ.

How does ShipLilly support trade financing?

ShipLilly provides trade financing solutions to help businesses manage their cash flow and facilitate international transactions. Our financing options can cover various aspects of the shipping process, including purchasing inventory and covering shipping costs. By partnering with us, you can access flexible financing solutions that align with your business needs and enhance your operational efficiency.

About BIS Digital, Inc.
-----------------------

BIS will develop & deliver the finest customized digital recording solutions available in the marketplace. We will support our customers with an unmatched technical & service team. Year upon year, we will bring the industry & our customers measurable value, exceptional performance and constant innovation. Our ultimate mission is to earn the trust and confidence of our customers each and every day. HISTORY : In 1982, The First Compact Disk Player Was Launched. Coincidentally, So Was BIS Digital. Granted, back then our cutting-edge recording technology consisted of dictation and transcriptions services. We had all of one employee, and a single county made up our entire corporate footprint. However, by 1985 we were in three counties providing digital recording solutions to numerous hospitals. Five years later, we were serving over 100 hospitals in six states. Then, at the dawn of the new millennia, BIS introduced digital recording solutions to the courts & government. This changed everything. In 2005, we launched our flagship product, DCR, under the BIS brand & haven’t looked back since. Today, we provide turnkey recording & communications management solutions to more than 4,000 customers. This includes over 2,000 courtrooms, stretching up &d down the east coast and beyond. Not to mention, multiple governmental agencies, hospitals, law enforcement departments & medical offices. Our unique ability to integrate advanced computer technology & digital recording software with the latest equipment – microphones, monitors, mixers, public address systems, and more – allows BIS to deliver customized solutions that provide unmatched communications control. It’s somewhat fitting that we were born the same year consumers discovered the CD player. After all, this marked the dawn of the digital age for so many. More than that, it serves to remind us that progress never sleeps; that today’s breakthroughs will more sooner than later become tomorrow’s relics.

HBL was the first commercial bank to be established in Pakistan in 1947. Over the years, HBL has grown its branch network and maintained its position as the largest private sector bank with over 1,700 branches and 2,000 ATMs globally and a customer base exceeding ten million relationships. The Government of Pakistan privatized HBL in 2004 through which AKFED acquired 51% of the Bank's shareholding and the management control. The remaining 41.5% shareholding by the Government of Pakistan was divested in April 2015. AKFED continues to retain 51% shareholding in HBL while the remaining shareholding is held by individuals, local and foreign institutions and funds including CDC Group Plc which holds 5% and International Finance Corporation which holds 3%. With a global presence in over 25 countries spanning across four continents, HBL is also the largest domestic multinational. The Bank is expanding its presence in principal international markets including the UK, UAE, South and Central Asia, Africa and the Far East. The key areas of operations encompass product offerings and services in Retail and Consumer Banking. HBL also has the largest Corporate Banking portfolio in the country with an active Investment Banking arm. Notre approche nous permet de vous assister dans toutes les phases clés de vos projets technologiques, qu’ils soient modestes ou d’envergure, par l’analyse adéquate de vos besoins, la gestion et la réalisation des déploiements et le support technique.

Surpasser les attentes de nos clients et partenaires par la mise en œuvre de solutions technologiques accessibles, optimisées et personnalisées par une équipe d’experts professionnels et passionnés est la mission qui nous anime et que supporte toute l’équipe de BGM Informatique.

About Safran Electronics & Defense, Avionics USA, LLC.

Safran Electronics & Defense, Avionics USA, LLC, a US incorporated company with Headquarters in Dallas, Texas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Safran Electronics & Defense, a Safran group company. Safran Electronics & Defense, Avionics USA, LLC, provides high quality avionics products and services to aircraft and helicopters. These include product design, technical support, MRO (maintenance, repair and overhaul) services, and marketing and sales of commercial aerospace products including integrated cockpit display systems, avionics illuminated push button switches, helicopter autopilot systems, flight control components, aircraft condition and monitoring systems, and flight operations quality assurance software for aircrafts.  
  
Safran Electronics & Defense is a world leader in the supply of solutions and services in optronics, avionics, electronics and critical software for both civil and military markets. Safran Electronics & Defense is the No. 1 company in Europe and No. 3 worldwide for inertial navigation systems used in air, land and naval applications. The Institute of International Finance (IIF) is the global association of the financial industry, with about 400 members from more than 60 countries. Singapore Exchange (SGX) is the Asian Gateway, connecting investors in search of Asian growth to corporate issuers in search of global capital. SGX represents the premier access point for managing Asian capital and investment exposure, and is Asia’s most international exchange with more than 40% of companies listed on SGX originating outside of Singapore. SGX offers its clients the world’s biggest offshore market for Asian equity futures, centred on Asia’s three largest economies – China, India and Japan. In addition to offering a fully integrated value chain from trading and clearing, to settlement and depository services, SGX is also Asia’s pioneering central clearing house. Headquartered in Asia’s most globalised city, and centred within the AAA strength and stability of Singapore’s island nation, SGX is a leading Asian counterparty for the clearing of financial and commodity products.

About Carver County
-------------------

One of the fastest growing Counties in the state, it is no secret that Carver County is a great place to live, work, and play. Carver County offers the ideal combination of a picturesque natural setting and attractive professional opportunities.  
  
Carver County is a great place to live…Carver County communities have received a number of awards and accolades highlighting their first-class livability. About 100,000 people call Carver County home. The County offers a blend of fast pace suburban communities and pleasant rural towns. Our communities offer respected and growing schools and reputable medical facilities. Since 2013, the County has been ranked the healthiest in Minnesota.  
  
Carver County is a great place to work…Many employers both large and small call Carver County home. The County has a diverse industrial base with a strong concentration of advanced manufacturing. Highway 212 – a four-lane freeway – provides a critical transportation link between the metro area and points west.  
  
Carver County is a great place to play…Carver County is home to an array of outstanding recreational resources, including renowned golf courses, beautiful lakes, and many miles of hiking and biking trails through breathtaking parks. Bordered on the south by the wildlife-rich Minnesota River Valley, the County is home to the Minnesota Landscape Arboretum, Chanhassen Dinner Theaters, Lake Waconia -- the second largest lake in the Twin Cities. Hazeltine National Golf Course, site of the 2016 Ryder Cup, has hosted the 2009 PGA Championship and the 1991 US Open, among others.  
  
Carver County is enjoying a period of surging momentum and growth. Steeped in a rich history along the Minnesota River, our culture, community passion, and pride have made our county what it is today. Uniquely endowed by nature, and positioned just outside the urban center, Carver County truly does provide the best place in which to live, work, and play.

About Red Varden Studios
------------------------

Red Varden Studios is a 21st century boutique content production company based in Los Angeles that produces television, film and digital content for multiple platforms. Red Varden Studios was founded by Zig Gauthier, building on his 20 years of experience in Hollywood. During this time, he has gained experience as a network executive, studio executive, freelance producer, collaborator, career-building expert and entrepreneur. After receiving his undergraduate degree from UCLA in Political Science and an MBA from Loyola Marymount University, he began is career at Peter Guber’s Mandalay Entertainment. He later worked as a development executive at Fox TV Studios, before moving on to the network side as Co-head of Alternative Programming/VP at NBC Universal’s Syfy Channel. Later, he held original programming VP roles at Fox Cable Networks/Fox Sports Net and the Game Show Network. Cumulatively, he has developed, produced and/or overseen scripted television, non-scripted television, digital content, films, commercials and other unique content-driven projects.  
  
After a career as a tv executive, Gauthier works as a producer on such shows as Dancing With The Stars, Big Brother, Executed With Deborah Norville, Top Shot, Celebrity Big Brother, Auction Hunters, Ghost Hunters, Marriage Boot Camp, American Grit, Catch A Contractor, Exposed With Deborah Norville, Hollywood Medium, Venom Hunters, Tattoo Rescue, Utopia, R&B Divas Los Angeles and more.  
  
In addition to his work experience, Gauthier has also been a champion of diversity issues (socioeconomic, ethnic, cultural, religious, etc.) and mentoring. He is a former Board Member of the Newscorp. Diversity Advisory Board and a Diversity Committee Member of the TV Academy.

About Flint Institute of Arts
-----------------------------

The Flint Institute of Arts is the second largest art museum in the State of Michigan and one of the largest museum art schools in the nation. Each year, more than 160,000 people visit the FIA’s galleries (free of charge) and participate in FIA programs and services.  
  
For more than 85 years, the FIA has been responsible for acquiring, protecting and presenting a collection of art and artifacts spanning continents and 5,000 years. The world renowned collection, which now exceeds 8,000 objects, is significant for its depth of important European and American paintings and sculptures, 15th century to the present, and its extensive holdings of decorative and applied arts including important ethnographic study collections dating back five millennia.  
  
The FIA promotes the power of the visual arts by providing lifelong learning opportunities to engage and educate a diverse regional audience. The FIA is committed to making art available, approachable, and accessible to all through a broad range of interpretive programs that allow multiple ways of accessing information on the permanent collection and temporary exhibitions. Films and videos shown in the FIA’s 330 seat Theater are selected to appeal to adults, college students, and senior citizens. Printed exhibition and collection catalogues, gallery guides, school brochures, audio guide entries, and online resources are produced to enhance educational opportunities.  
  
The FIA Art School runs at full capacity from 9a to 9p with an annual enrollment of more than 1,700 students. The Art School remains dedicated to the educational enlightenment of the public through formal studio instruction in drawing, painting, photography, mixed media, printmaking, ceramics, glass mosaic, fiber, and metal sculpture. The school also provides summer camps for youth, free family activities, and a pre‐college portfolio development program for gifted high school students.

Wilson Sporting Goods Co., a subsidiary of Amer Sports Corporation, is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of high performance sports equipment, apparel and accessories. Since 1914, Wilson has been on the mission to help athletes everywhere reach their true potential.  
  
For more than 100 years, Wilson has studied the powerful and symbiotic relationship an athlete has with his/her equipment. With that relationship in mind, the Company invents, designs and engineers game-changing products using state-of-the-art sports technologies and expertise, and the insights and ambassadorship of its 10,000 member strong Wilson Advisory Staff. This Staff is comprised of top youth, college, amateur, and professional athletes, teams, coaches, programs and leagues from around the world.  
  
The Company’s unwavering commitment to innovation pushes its sports into new territories, including digitally connected, socially sharable, and highly customizable products. This dedication and focus is woven throughout the Wilson global culture, which thrives on collaboration, experimentation, passion, teamwork, persistence, ingenuity and positivity.  
  
Today, millions of Tennis, Baseball, Softball, Football, Basketball, Soccer, Volleyball and Golf athletes choose to use Wilson products as they prepare for and compete in matches, games, tournaments and championships.  
  
Wilson is headquartered in Chicago, IL, with offices and staff in more than 100 countries. The global Wilson team is 1,600 strong and growing.

About Pacific Gas and Electric Company
--------------------------------------

Pacific Gas and Electric Company, incorporated in California in 1905, is one of the largest combination natural gas and electric utilities in the United States. Based in San Francisco, the company is a subsidiary of PG&E Corporation.  
  
There are approximately 20,000 employees who carry out Pacific Gas and Electric Company's primary business—the transmission and delivery of energy. The company provides natural gas and electric service to approximately 15 million people throughout a 70,000-square-mile service area in northern and central California.  
  
Fast Facts  
  
\* Service area stretches from Eureka in the north to Bakersfield in the south, and from the Pacific Ocean in the west to the Sierra Nevada in the east  
  
\* 141,215 circuit miles of electric distribution lines and 18,616 circuit miles of interconnected transmission lines  
  
\* 42,141 miles of natural gas distribution pipelines and 6,438 miles of transportation pipelines  
  
\* 5.1 million electric customer accounts  
  
\* 4.3 million natural gas customer accounts

About Cincinnati Sub-Zero
-------------------------

We have proudly supplied world class temperature management solutions to our customers since we first opened our doors in 1940. Our primary focus at this time was manufacturing industrial freezers. The Cincinnati Sub-Zero brand quickly became synonymous with long-lasting, reliable, and high quality products.  
  
From our humble beginnings, CSZ has grown from a supplier of industrial freezers to become a leading manufacturer of standard and custom environmental test chambers. These test chambers now include a wide variety of thermal, vibration, humidity, altitude solutions, and much more. Over time it became clear that the addition of a testing laboratory would not only provide more opportunities for growth but would allow us to provide a more complete portfolio of environmental testing solutions to our customers.  
  
Throughout our more than 70 year journey to become one of the premier worldwide suppliers of environmental testing solutions we have held true to the philosophy that the customer comes first. This dedication to customer service has allowed us to work with leading manufacturers in over 22 industries including aviation, automotive, aerospace, defense, medical, energy, to name a few.  
  
Located in Sharonville, Ohio, our campus is comprised of two buildings with over 150,000 square feet of manufacturing space. Each building has been tailored to provide flexibility, comfort, and safety for our employees while providing room for continued growth and innovation. Our testing facilities consist of two locations with one being on the main campus in Sharonville, OH and a second laboratory in Sterling Heights, MI.

About Denver Health
-------------------

Denver Health, headquartered at 777 Bannock St., Denver, CO, is a premier integrated academic health care system renowned for its high-quality, efficient services and commitment to community health. As Colorado's primary safety net institution, Denver Health serves a diverse population, providing critical care to approximately 185,000 individuals, including 67,000 children annually. The system encompasses a broad range of services, including the Rocky Mountain Regional Level I Trauma Center, a 525-bed acute care medical center, and a comprehensive 911 emergency medical response system.  
  
In addition to its acute care facilities, Denver Health operates nine family health centers and 17 school-based health centers, ensuring accessible healthcare for all demographics, particularly underserved populations. The organization also includes the Rocky Mountain Poison and Drug Center and the Denver Public Health Department, further solidifying its role as a vital community resource. Over the past decade, Denver Health has provided more than $3.3 billion in care for the uninsured, exemplifying its mission-driven approach to healthcare.  
  
Denver Health is recognized for its innovative implementation of lean principles in healthcare, which enhances performance and quality improvements while maintaining financial stability. The organization is committed to fostering a diverse workforce and is an equal opportunity employer, welcoming applicants from all backgrounds, including women, minorities, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. Located just minutes from downtown Denver, Denver Health not only prioritizes health but also enriches the community through its extensive services and commitment to equity in healthcare access. For more information on career opportunities, visit the Denver Health Career Center at http://www.denverhealth.org/about-us/career-center.

What types of delivery services does Yodel offer?

Yodel provides a variety of delivery services tailored to meet both B2B and B2C needs. Their offerings include standard next-day delivery, same-day delivery, and international shipping options. Additionally, Yodel specializes in flexible delivery solutions such as Click and Collect, which allows customers to pick up their parcels from designated locations.

How can businesses integrate Yodel's services into their operations?

Businesses can easily integrate Yodel's delivery services through their API, which allows for seamless order processing and tracking. Yodel also offers tailored solutions for retailers, including dedicated account management and customized delivery options to enhance the customer experience. Businesses can contact Yodel's sales team for more information on setting up an account.

What industries does Yodel support with its delivery solutions?

Yodel supports a wide range of industries, including retail, e-commerce, and logistics. Their services are designed to cater to businesses of all sizes, from small startups to large enterprises. Yodel's expertise in the retail supply chain makes them a preferred partner for companies looking to optimize their parcel delivery processes.

What types of shredding services does Redishred Capital Corp. offer?

Redishred Capital Corp. provides a comprehensive range of shredding services, including document shredding, product destruction, and media & hard drive destruction. Their document shredding services ensure that sensitive information is securely destroyed, while product destruction services cater to businesses needing to dispose of obsolete or defective products. Additionally, their media & hard drive destruction services guarantee that all data stored on electronic devices is irretrievable, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.

How does Redishred ensure the security of my documents during the shredding process?

Redishred Capital Corp. prioritizes security by implementing strict protocols throughout the shredding process. They utilize secure containers for document collection, and all shredding is performed at their certified facilities. The company also provides a certificate of destruction upon completion, which serves as proof that your documents have been securely destroyed. Their trained staff adheres to industry best practices to ensure that your sensitive information is protected at all times.

What industries does Redishred serve?

Yes, Redishred Capital Corp. offers on-site shredding services, allowing clients to witness the shredding process firsthand. This service is particularly beneficial for businesses that prioritize transparency and security. Redishred’s mobile shredding trucks are equipped to handle large volumes of documents on-site, ensuring that sensitive information is destroyed immediately and securely.
